title: Senior SDET – Automation Framework Architect (Playwright, Selenium, API, CI/CD)
description:
Senior SDET – Automation Framework Architect (Playwright, Selenium, API, CI/CD)THE ROLE

Own test strategy, quality architecture, and the automated regression infrastructure for Securly Flex — the flex period scheduling and attendance platform that 1,000+ schools use every school day to place students into intervention, enrichment, and support sessions.

**Flex decides where students are supposed to be.**
A defect in Autoassign placement, capacity limits, separation rules, roster sync, or attendance recording does not just break a feature — it can put a student in the wrong room, leave a must-attend intervention empty, place students together who are required to be kept apart, or send inaccurate attendance into a district's student information system. The test infrastructure you build is the last line of defense before production.

**This is an engineering leadership role, not a QA role.**
You will define what "production-ready" means for Flex, build the automation platform that enforces it through CI/CD quality gates, and write production-quality code for that platform yourself. You will also serve as the team's expert on rules-engine correctness and edge-case testing — your understanding of how Flex's rules interact (priorities, capacity limits, restricted sessions, sign-up cutoffs, and check-in controls) directly shapes both the test suite and the implementation team's design decisions.

**Location:**
Pune, India (Hybrid – 2 days onsite)
  
**Experience:**
6–10+ years
  
**Reports to:**
Director of Quality Engineering

WHAT YOU'LL DO

* ****Own the quality bar.****
  Define what "passing" means for Flex: establish written quality criteria covering scheduling correctness, data integrity, access control, and performance that gate production releases.
* ****Test the rules engine.****
  Design and implement automated test suites covering Autoassign placement logic — student choice, teacher priority, must-attend assignments, rostered and restricted sessions, at-risk designations, seat and room capacity, separation (contact control) rules, conflict detection, and the guarantee that manual registrations are never overwritten — plus the edge cases around them: conflicting rules, boundary conditions, concurrent registrations at capacity limits and sign-up cutoffs, API calls that skip UI validation, and permission boundaries.
* ****Gate every release.****
  Build CI/CD quality gates that prevent regressions from reaching production; own the pipeline configuration and ensure the quality bar is enforced, not advisory.
* ****Set performance baselines.****
  Measure and establish written performance baselines for peak-load moments: sign-up windows opening and closing, Autoassign runs before each flex period, and attendance taking across thousands of concurrent users; define the thresholds that constitute a performance regression.
* ****Cover web, mobile, and integrations.****
  Own end-to-end coverage across web, mobile, and integrations: student, teacher, and admin workflows; the student mobile app; email, in-product, and push notifications; roster imports and attendance exports to the SIS; and the shared rostering and single sign-on Flex runs on with Securly Pass.
* ****Build the framework.****
  Architect and build the Flex automation framework: reusable libraries, test data utilities for roster and attendance files, parallel execution, and reporting that the whole team extends — and contribute fixes to product code where it improves testability.
* ****Mentor and scale.****
  Mentor engineers on test architecture as a first-class discipline, and bring AI-assisted tooling into how the team generates scenarios, triages failures, and scales coverage.
* ****Shape architecture.****
  Partner with your technical lead and the Distinguished Engineer on architecture and testability decisions, and influence testing standards across teams beyond your own squad.
* ****Own incidents.****
  Join the on-call rotation and own the full incident lifecycle for quality regressions: detection, diagnosis, resolution, and retrospective.

SKILLS & REQUIREMENTSMust-Have

* ****Test framework architecture****
  — designing automation frameworks from scratch (page object or screenplay patterns, BDD where it fits, parallel execution, reporting) that other engineers extend. You build the platform, not just the scripts.
* ****Test automation (SDET-level)****
  — Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium for UI plus API-level automation (REST, contract testing). Must automate business-rule behavior — placement decisions, capacity and eligibility rules, state transitions — not just UI interaction tests.
* ****CI/CD quality gates****
  — integrating test suites into pipelines; defining and enforcing regression gates for a multi-tenant product used daily by 1,000+ schools. At this level you own the definition of the bar, not just the tests that check it.
* ****Rules-engine and data-integrity testing****
  — designing deterministic test data and fixtures for scheduling, allocation, or eligibility logic; building data utilities that validate rosters, registrations, and attendance across CSV/XML imports, exports, and concurrent edits.
* ****Strong programming****
  — JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Python at production quality (TypeScript strongly preferred). Your test code is held to the same review standard as product code.
* ****Technical communication****
  — ability to produce written quality criteria, test strategy and edge-case documentation, and performance baseline documents that the implementation team, engineering manager, PM, Support, and leadership can act on.
* ****Education & experience****
  — Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, with 6 to 10+ years of hands-on SDET / test automation experience.

Strongly Preferred

* ****Performance & concurrency testing****
  — k6, JMeter, Gatling, or Locust; modeling burst traffic (thousands of users acting in the same minute) and catching race conditions at capacity limits and sign-up cutoffs.
* ****AI-assisted test engineering****
  — using AI tools to generate test scenarios, triage failures, or scale framework adoption across teams.
* ****Security & access-control testing****
  — role-based permissions (student / teacher / admin), multi-tenant data isolation between districts, and student data privacy expectations.

Nice to Have

* ****Mobile test automation****
  — Appium, Maestro, Detox, or similar for iOS and Android; push notification and device-fragmentation coverage.
* ****Integration testing****
  — SIS data import/export, rostering sync, single sign-on, and notification delivery (email, in-product, push).
* ****K-12 EdTech domain****
  — understanding of bell schedules, flex and advisory periods, MTSS intervention tiers, and how districts manage SIS data helps design realistic test scenarios.

WHO YOU ARE

* ****You test the edge cases, not just the happy path.****
  You test the ways the system should fail and doesn't, and you document those cases so the implementation team designs against them.
* ****You have built automation frameworks from the ground up — not just inherited them — and other engineers have built on what you designed.****
* ****You treat test architecture as a first-class engineering discipline.****
  A feature without a regression suite is not finished — and you enforce that standard through CI/CD gates, not just code review comments.
* ****You define what "quality" means on a product that decides where students are supposed to be, and produce written criteria that hold the codebase to that standard across every engineer and every release.****
* ****You are hands-on at a senior level****
  — you still write the framework code, and you raise the bar for everyone who writes tests after you.
  **Experience shipping product feature code is a bonus, not a requirement.**
* ****Your edge-case documentation and performance baselines are used by the implementation team to make better architecture decisions.****
  Your influence extends past your own work.
* ****You own your area end to end with minimal oversight, and you resolve ambiguity in requirements and design tradeoffs instead of waiting for a fully formed spec.****

ABOUT SECURLY

**Tech Giant Scale. EdTech Innovation. Unmatched Student Impact.**

Securly processes over 1.1 billion requests per day and 54 TB of data daily, protecting more than 20 million students across 20,000+ schools globally. Since pioneering the first cloud-based web filter for K–12 in 2013, Securly has built one of the most trusted, high-scale platforms for student safety, wellness, and engagement.

By turning data into meaningful, actionable intelligence, Securly enables schools to identify risk earlier, reduce harmful incidents, and strengthen student support — driving measurable improvements in student safety and wellbeing at scale.

We are proud to be consistently recognized as a Top Place to Work, named a Top 40 Most Used EdTech platform, and included on the GSV 150 list as one of the most transformational growth companies in digital learning and workforce skills.

BENEFITS

* Comprehensive Health Insurance (employee, parents, spouse, children)
* Accidental & Term Life Insurance
* Learning & Development reimbursement
* Paid Time Off
* Public Holidays (10+ per year)
* Retirement Benefits (EPF & gratuity)
* Parental Leave (as per statutory norms)

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Securly is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to inclusion, fairness, and respect. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

title: Senior Controls Automation Engineer
description:
Johnson Controls is seeking a Senior Controls & Automation Engineer to support the development, testing, commissioning and troubleshooting of PLC/HMI control systems for Hydraulic Power Units (HPU) and CAFS / INERT Fire Suppression Systems.
  
  
This is a hands-on role focused on PLC software development, HMI configuration, FAT/iFAT/SAT execution, commissioning and operational support across supplier facilities, JCI sites and project locations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Develop, modify and troubleshoot PLC software using Siemens TIA Portal & Rockwell Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk experience.
* Configure and support HMI/SCADA applications such as WinCC, WinCC Unified, FactoryTalk or similar platforms.
* Execute and support Pre-FAT, FAT, iFAT, SAT and commissioning activities.
* Implement and verify Cause & Effect Matrices, interlocks, alarms, shutdowns and control sequences.
* Troubleshoot PLC, HMI, I/O, instrumentation and communication issues.
* Support controlled software updates, testing and issue resolution.
* Work closely with engineering teams, suppliers and client representatives to achieve project milestones.

**Essential Requirements**

* Degree in Electrical, Automation, Control or Instrumentation Engineering.
* Minimum 5 years' hands-on PLC programming experience.
* Strong experience with Siemens TIA Portal and Studio 5000 (mandatory).
* HMI development experience with WinCC, WinCC Unified, FactoryTalk or equivalent.
* Proven experience delivering FAT, iFAT, SAT and commissioning activities.
* Knowledge of industrial communications including Profinet, Modbus TCP/IP and Ethernet/IP.
* Experience implementing control philosophies, Cause & Effect requirements, interlocks and permissives.

Desirable Experience
  
  

* Oil & Gas, Marine or Offshore projects.
* Fire Suppression Systems, HPU packages or safety-related control systems.
* Functional Safety awareness (IEC 61508 / IEC 61511).
* OT Cyber Security awareness (IEC 62443).
* Rockwell Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk experience.

What We're Looking For
  
  
A practical, hands-on Controls Engineer who can quickly understand control systems, solve automation problems, support project delivery, and work effectively with suppliers, clients and multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  
  
Travel within the UK, Turkey and Vietnam will be required for FAT, commissioning and project support activities.

**Become the force that turns every “what if” into “what’s next.”**
In a world where you can be anything,

**Director, Cloud Delivery Assurance**
**The Opportunity**
We have an opportunity for a
**Director, Cloud Delivery Assurance**
to build and lead our new Cloud Delivery Assurance team within SaaS Platform Engineering in Pune or Bangalore, India, reporting to the VP, Engineering.
  
  
In this pivotal role, you will make release readiness a defensible, engineering-owned decision. You will establish a team of automation and delivery-assurance engineers, define the roadmap from manual and inconsistent release checks to an automated artifact-promotion pipeline, and own the quality gates that govern promotion of SaaS software from development clusters through integration and staging environments into production.
  
  
Collaborating closely with Solutions QA, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, CloudOps, application, and platform teams, you will create the integration-quality, automation, and production-readiness operating model that validates the combined system before customers experience it. You will establish trusted environments, shared tooling, and evidence-based release-readiness gates while complementing—not duplicating—the charters of Solutions QA, DevOps, and SRE.
  
  
You are the ideal candidate if you have built quality or delivery-assurance organizations from the ground up, are fluent in Kubernetes-based cloud platforms and CI/CD, and are comfortable making clear, data-backed decisions when the evidence does not support a release.
  
  
**Be a Contributor — What You’ll Do**

* Build the CDA strategy, roadmap, operating model, and staffing plan; align scope, milestones, investment, and success measures with the SVP, Platform Engineering and peer engineering leaders
* Hire, lead, coach, and develop a team of one technical project manager and eight software development engineers in test; establish the team charter, operating cadence, engineering standards, and inclusive culture
* Own the automated artifact-promotion pipeline from CI build and security-scan validation through development-cluster smoke testing, integration and certification runs, staging certification, and production promotion
* Define, implement, and enforce quality gates for each promotion decision, including entry and exit criteria, required evidence, hold-and-return behavior, risk acceptance, and rollback expectations
* Serve as the accountable approver for promotion of SaaS software across development, integration, staging, and production environments; make go/no-go recommendations defensible with data
* Establish a common test-automation framework, shared libraries, and fit-for-purpose test environments for API, integration, end-to-end, regression, performance, and deployment-verification testing
* Apply AI-assisted engineering tools, including code assistants, test-generation capabilities, and intelligent analytics, to improve productivity, expand meaningful test coverage, identify risk patterns, and support—not replace—engineering judgment
* Govern responsible use of AI-generated code and test assets through human review, security and privacy controls, traceability, and measurable quality outcomes
* Deliver readiness scorecards, quality and risk heatmaps, coverage and escape-rate metrics, defect trends, mean-time-to-detect measures, and environment and release status for engineering leadership
* Partner with Solutions QA on end-to-end functional coverage and release sign-off, and with SRE on stress, scale, high availability, disaster recovery, and chaos testing

**Be Prepared — What You Bring**

* Fifteen or more years of experience in software engineering, quality engineering, test automation, platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, or delivery assurance, including five or more years leading and growing engineering or QA teams
* Proven success defining and delivering quality, automation, and release-readiness strategies for cloud-native SaaS platforms
* Deep understanding of Kubernetes, Linux, containers, public cloud environments such as AWS or GCP, distributed systems, and microservices
* Strong command of CI/CD practices, including pipeline design, artifact promotion, progressive delivery, canary releases, deployment verification, and automated quality gates using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Argo, or Spinnaker
* Expertise in test-automation architecture across API, integration, end-to-end, regression, performance, and production-readiness testing, with the technical depth to review designs and code
* Experience building metrics-driven programs using measures such as coverage, escape rate, defect trends, mean time to detect, release risk, and environment stability
* Practical experience using AI-assisted development, test-generation, analytics, automation, content-generation, or decision-support tools, with an understanding of responsible AI practices and appropriate human oversight
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority across QA, SRE, DevOps, product, application, and platform teams while maintaining a consistent quality bar under delivery pressure
* Experience hiring and scaling engineering teams in India, preferably across distributed or multi-site environments, and building an inclusive, high-accountability culture
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related technical field; a master’s degree is a plus

**Be Successful — Your Path**
**First 90 Days:**
Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors through Blox Buddies, and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short/long-term goals.
  
  
**Six Months:**

* Operate automated build and development-cluster validation gates for every release candidate, with promotion decisions recorded and evidence collected automatically
* Establish the common test-automation framework and shared libraries, with regression suites running on a predictable schedule against a protected certification baseline
* Launch readiness scorecards and quality-risk reporting, including AI-assisted aggregation and analysis of release evidence with human review and clear auditability
* Complete staffing and onboarding for the CDA team, with the technical project manager driving milestones, dependencies, and stakeholder communications

title: CSV & Software Validation Lead / Specialist
description:
**Designation: CSV & Software Validation Lead / Specialist**

**Preferred Experience: 3+ Years**

**Job Summary**

Aventior is seeking a CSV & Software Validation Specialist with experience in the biopharmaceutical, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industry. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of regulatory compliance, quality management, computerized system validation (CSV), and software testing within regulated environments.

The role involves ensuring that software applications and computerized systems meet applicable regulatory requirements, quality standards, and business specifications. The candidate will be responsible for developing and executing test cases, validating system functionality, documenting test results, managing defects, and supporting compliance activities in accordance with GxP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, and other relevant regulatory frameworks.

The candidate will collaborate with Quality Assurance, Software Development, Clinical Operations, IT, and Regulatory Affairs teams to ensure software quality, data integrity, and regulatory compliance throughout the software development and validation lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Regulatory Compliance & Quality Assurance**

* Ensure adherence to applicable GxP requirements, including GMP, GCP, and GLP, based on project and system requirements.
* Support compliance with FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU and UK regulations for electronic records, electronic signatures, audit trails, and access controls.
* Apply GAMP 5 principles and risk-based approaches to computerized system validation and software testing.
* Review and maintain SOPs, work instructions, validation documents, and quality records.
* Support compliance assessments, internal and external audits, client audits, and regulatory inspection readiness.
* Assist with deviation management, CAPA, change control, risk assessments, and compliance remediation activities.
* Support data integrity, security, traceability, and documentation requirements for regulated systems.

**2. Software Testing & Quality Engineering**

* Review business requirements, functional specifications, and technical documentation to identify test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
* Prepare and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test scenarios for software applications used in biopharma and life sciences.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and user acceptance testing (UAT), as applicable.
* Validate application workflows, data processing, user permissions, audit trails, electronic signatures, and system interfaces.
* Identify, document, track, and retest software defects in collaboration with development and QA teams.
* Maintain requirements traceability matrices (RTMs) to establish traceability between requirements, risks, test cases, and test results.
* Ensure testing activities are documented, reproducible, and aligned with approved procedures and validation protocols.
* Support test execution, defect triage, root-cause analysis, and resolution verification.
* Participate in release testing, regression testing, and post-implementation verification.

**3. Computerized System Validation (CSV)**

* Support validation activities for GxP-regulated software applications and computerized systems.
* Prepare and maintain validation lifecycle documentation, including User Requirements Specifications (URS), risk assessments, validation plans, and test protocols.
* Execute or support Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), and Performance Qualification (PQ), where applicable.
* Assist with validation of new systems, system upgrades, configuration changes, integrations, and software releases.
* Ensure validation evidence is complete, accurate, approved, and audit-ready.
* Support periodic reviews, change impact assessments, and revalidation activities based on risk and regulatory requirements.
* Apply risk-based validation principles in accordance with GAMP 5 and organizational quality procedures.

**4. Biopharma & Life Sciences Application Testing**

* Test and validate applications supporting clinical trials, clinical data management, pharmaceutical quality processes, laboratory operations, and regulatory workflows.
* Understand regulated-system requirements relating to patient data, clinical trial records, laboratory data, and electronic documentation.
* Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, access controls, audit trails, and system-generated records.
* Support testing of integrations between clinical, laboratory, quality management, and other enterprise applications.
* Help ensure that software changes do not compromise patient safety, product quality, data integrity, or regulatory compliance.
* Support HIPAA-related privacy and security requirements when applications handle protected health information (PHI).

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Computer Science, Information Technology, Quality Management, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in compliance, software testing, quality assurance, or computerized system validation within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, clinical research, or life sciences environments.
* Strong understanding of GxP regulations, including GMP, GCP, and GLP.
* Working knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, EU and UK regulations, and electronic records and electronic signature requirements.
* Hands-on experience in manual software testing, test case preparation, test execution, defect tracking, and regression testing.
* Hands on experience with QMS platforms like ServiceNow, Veeva, Master Control a huge plus.
* Experience preparing or executing validation protocols and maintaining validation documentation, including URS, IQ, OQ, PQ, and RTMs, as applicable.
* Knowledge of SDLC, STLC, requirements traceability, risk-based testing, and change management.
* Experience with CAPA, deviation management, change control, and audit documentation.
* Understanding of data integrity, audit trails, access controls, and security requirements in regulated systems.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple testing and compliance activities.

**Company Overview:**

**Aventior**

is a leading provider of innovative, end-to-end technology solutions, empowering businesses across diverse industries to solve complex challenges and accelerate growth. We harness the power of cutting-edge technologies such as
**artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), MLOps, and DevOps**

to build scalable, future-ready solutions that drive measurable business outcomes for the life science industry.

Our expertise extends across the entire data lifecycle. We offer comprehensive data development and management services, including
**cloud data architecture, universal data models, Data Transformation & ETL, data lakes, user management, Analytics & visualization,**

and
**automated data capture**

for unstructured and semi-structured sources such as scanned documents. These capabilities enable organizations to unlock the full value of their data and make faster, more informed decisions.

At Aventior, our strength lies in combining
**deep industry expertise**

with
**advanced technical capabilities**

. Our teams work closely with clients to design and deliver tailored solutions that align with their unique business needs—whether it’s optimizing operations, enhancing customer experiences, or driving strategic decision-making.

We bring a
**holistic, cross-industry perspective**

to every engagement, supported by a strong foundation in
**design, implementation, innovation, migration, and ongoing support**

. With a
**global delivery model**

, a
**multi-country presence**

, and a team of highly skilled professionals, Aventior is well-positioned to deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes at scale.

Key responsibilities include building reusable Python- and SQL-based validation frameworks, supporting batch and cloud-based execution models, identifying data anomalies, validating end-to-end data flows, and embedding robust data quality controls throughout the development lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end test planning, execution, and delivery for data validation and regression testing initiatives, ensuring quality, schedule, and stakeholder expectations are met.
* Manage and mentor offshore/onshore QA teams, including resource planning, task allocation, deliverable reviews, and adherence to testing best practices.

* Collaborate with business, engineering, and product teams to define requirements, resolve issues, ensure test coverage, and embed quality controls across the delivery lifecycle.
* Perform source-to-target data validation across legacy and modern systems, including SQL Server and cloud-based data environments.
* Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, duplication handling, referential integrity, schema structures, metadata, lineage, and business-rule conformance.
* Build and maintain automation-first regression testing frameworks using Python, PySpark, SQL, and reusable validation utilities.
* Execute field-level, dataset-level, transformation-level, and aggregate-level data checks across source, staging, warehouse, data lake, and downstream systems.
* Validate ETL/ELT pipelines, post-trade data flows, stored procedures, batch jobs, and cloud-based execution workflows.
* Design reusable test cases, validation scenarios, reconciliation checks, automated scripts, and regression packs for repeatable data-quality assurance.
* Write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries and stored procedures across SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or similar platforms.
* Translate business rules, stored procedure logic, and post-trade process flows into automated validation scripts and assertions.
* Build Python-based utilities, APIs, CLI tools, and reusable frameworks to support data validation, orchestration, API integrations, and reporting workflows.
* Integrate regression tests, data validation checks, SQL deployables, and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab, or equivalent tools.
* Automate execution of AutoSys jobs, batch processes, stored procedures, and validation scripts across development, UAT, and production environments.
* Work with engineering teams to embed data quality controls into pipelines, releases, and operational workflows.
* Identify data anomalies, schema mismatches, duplicate records, null-handling issues, transformation failures, reconciliation breaks, and integrity violations.
* Log defects with clear evidence, impact analysis, root-cause observations, and business context.
* Support capital markets and post-trade validation across allocations, clearing, settlement, confirmations, reconciliations, market data, reference data, and downstream reporting.

**Key competencies**

* 8–12 years of hands-on experience in Data QA, Data Engineering QA, or Python-based automation roles and proven experience leading QA teams, test planning, estimation, execution, defect management, and end-to-end test delivery across complex data programs.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate test status, risks, quality metrics, and release readiness to business and technology leadership.
* Experience establishing test strategies, governance frameworks, quality standards, resource planning, and mentoring distributed QA teams.
* Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional collaboration, manage competing priorities, mitigate delivery risks, and ensure

successful project outcomes in Agile environments.
  
  

* Strong Python skills for data validation, automation framework development, regression testing, and pipeline verification.
* Working knowledge of PySpark for validating large-scale data pipelines and distributed datasets.
* Solid SQL skills for source-to-target validation, reconciliation, complex queries, stored procedures, schema checks, and defect analysis.
* Experience in data QA, ETL/ELT testing, data pipeline testing, and regression testing across legacy and modern platforms.
* Proven experience building automation-first regression frameworks, reusable validation scripts, test cases, and data verification utilities.
* Strong understanding of data quality dimensions including accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, referential integrity, and business-rule conformance.
* Experience validating metadata, schema structures, data types, constraints, lineage, transformation logic, and downstream outputs.
* Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitLab, with the ability to integrate automated tests and quality gates into deployment pipelines.
* Familiarity with batch orchestration tools such as AutoSys, Control-M, or Airflow.
* Good analytical skills to understand post-trade, financial, market data, or reference data and translate them into repeatable validation scenarios.
* Experience with JIRA, XRay, agile delivery practices, defect management, and QA process governance.
* Proficiency in leveraging AI-assisted tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot to accelerate test case generation, SQL development, data validation, defect analysis, documentation, and test data creation.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Domain Experience (Must Have)
* Strong experience in Fixed Income Capital Markets domain
* Good understanding of Fixed Income products, reference data, pricing, securities, positions, settlements, and trade lifecycle concepts
* Experience working with market data, reference data, and regulatory reporting-related data sets

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to Azure, AWS, ADF, containers, Kubernetes, or cloud-based data platforms.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or similar platforms.
* Exposure to Hadoop, Spark, Databricks, cloud data lakes, and Big Data validation.
* Experience validating batch, streaming, real-time, and Kafka-based ingestion pipelines.
* Capital markets domain exposure, especially post-trade, market data, reference data, trade data, or ION/blotter platform

integrations.
  
  

* Exposure to DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, and code quality tools such as Terraform, Bicep, Sonar, Mend, or ZAP.

title: Performance Engineering Architect
description:
**About Avaya**
Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.
  
  
The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

**Job Information**
Job Code: 00194001
  
  
Job Family: Research and Development
  
  
Job Function: Software Engineering
  
  
**About The Job**
We are seeking a Performance Architect – QA to join our R&D team as a senior individual contributor. The ideal candidate is a hands-on performance engineering expert with a deep architectural pedigree in core products, platforms, or large-scale enterprise software. You will shape our overarching performance strategy and partner closely with Product Engineering, Architecture, SRE, DevOps, and R&D teams to deliver highly scalable, resilient, and low-latency products.
  
  
In this role, you will own the performance engineering domain from an architectural perspective—driving strategies that build performance into the core system design. While performance remains your primary focus, you will also bring critical insights into end-to-end, system-level Quality Assurance. By bridging the gap between functional automation and non-functional engineering, you will ensure a holistic approach to system reliability, helping elevate our entire QA framework. This role involves technical ownership and cross-functional influence, with no people-management responsibilities.
  
  
**About You**

* Experience: 15+ years in QA, software/performance engineering, and automation, with 10+ years of hands-on SaaS experience. Mandatory background in a Core Product or R&D organization.
* Architecture & Systems: Expertise in distributed systems, microservices, cloud-native patterns, multi-tenant platforms, and load balancing (e.g., Istio service mesh).
* Performance & Reliability: Experience establishing data-driven SLOs/SLIs and error budgets. Proven ability to lead chaos engineering initiatives (fault injection, failovers) and capacity planning using real-time SRE/APM telemetry.
* Testing & Tooling: Expert in performance testing frameworks (K6, JMeter, Gatling, or custom simulators) and stateful/protocol-level fuzzing (HTTP/2, gRPC, WebSocket). Advanced proficiency in functional automation (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium).
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on with Docker, Terraform, and Kubernetes (AKS preferred) for autoscaling and high availability.
* Development & CI/CD: Strong programming skills in Java, Python, C#, or Go. Seamless integration of continuous verification into CI/CD pipelines.
* Observability: Mastery of APM tools, distributed tracing, database tuning, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

**Why Join & Who Should Apply**
This is a high-impact role focused heavily on technical depth, engineering judgment, and cross-functional mentorship. You are a strong fit if you:
  
  

* Have scaled complex, distributed products in an R&D environment and deeply understand the entire product lifecycle.
* Can authoritatively influence architectural decisions using data-driven performance insights.
* Possess a big-picture vision for end-to-end QA, optimizing both functional boundaries and non-functional baselines.
* Can perfectly balance hands-on coding, debugging, and production analysis with strategic architecture ownership.

**Education**
Bachelor degree or equivalent experience
  
  
Advance Degree preferred
  
  
**Preferred Certifications**
**Footer**
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

All qualified applicants and employees receive equal treatment without consideration for race, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other protected characteristic. An increasing share of this work is powered by AI agents designed to handle complex scientific and commercial datasets. This role is split roughly evenly between internal research (developing reusable agent harness components, benchmark evaluations, and reliability frameworks) and client delivery (architecting, deploying, and scaling production-ready agentic systems).
  
  
**Requirements**

* Professional Experience: 2-3 years of professional software engineering experience, including substantive work building LLM-based or agentic systems (beyond prompt-level experimentation)

* Core Software Engineering & Python: Strong Python skills with production-grade test coverage, typing, asyncio, Pydantic, Pytest, packaging, version control, CI/CD, and robust API design
* LLM & Agent Frameworks: Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, function/tool calling, structured outputs, streaming, and context window management. Experience building or extending orchestration frameworks (such as LangGraph, deepagents, OpenAI Agents SDK, or custom harnesses) with a clear view on framework utility
* Non-Deterministic Evaluation: Ability to define success criteria, design evaluation datasets, and systematically evaluate non-deterministic AI outputs
* Cloud & Shipping: Working knowledge of containerization and at least one major cloud provider to ship and maintain services independently
* Communication & Adaptability: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to represent technical positions credibly and thrive amid shifting project priorities.

**Nice to have**

* Domain Knowledge: Prior exposure to healthcare, pharma, or biotech data (clinical trial data, real-world evidence, regulatory submissions, pharmacovigilance, or commercial analytics) and standards (CDISC, SNOMED, MedDRA)
* Regulated Environments: Familiarity with GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA, GDPR, audit logging, and formal system validation
* Observability & Protocols: Hands-on experience with LLM tracing tools (LangSmith, Langfuse, Braintrust, OpenTelemetry) or developing and hosting MCP servers
* Retrieval & Models: Experience with RAG pipelines, vector search (pgvector, Qdrant, Weaviate), fine-tuning, distillation, or model serving (vLLM, Bedrock, Vertex AI)
* DevOps & Data Engineering: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, GitHub Actions, AWS/Azure) alongside large-scale data processing using Polars, Pandas, DuckDB, and advanced SQL
* Consulting & Ecosystem Engagement: Prior consulting/client services experience, active use of agentic developer tooling (such as Claude Code), or open-source contributions/publications in agent architectures and evaluations

**Responsibilities**

* Harness & Orchestration Architecture: Design and build core agent harnesses, covering function calling, tool interfaces, context assembly, retrieval integration, subagent delegation, retry logic, and failure handling
* Prototype to Production Delivery: Take agentic systems from initial concept to scalable production, managing deployment, monitoring, cost, latency, and operational support against live enterprise client data
* Evaluation Infrastructure: Build and maintain rigorous evaluation suites, task benchmarks, scoring rubrics, and regression tests using tools like Langfuse, Pydantic Logfire, or custom SDKs to drive architectural decisions
* System & Tool Integration: Integrate client enterprise systems, data sources, and internal APIs as accessible agent tools, including building and managing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers
* Solution Consulting & Requirements Translation: Translate ambiguous client requirements into robust agent architectures, clearly advising stakeholders when an agentic pattern is—or is not—the right solution
* Stakeholder Communication: Interface directly with client stakeholders and articulate technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical audiences
* Tooling Transfer & Documentation: Contribute reusable harness components to shared internal tooling and document design decisions to meet audit, validation, and handover standards

**Benefits**

* Paid PTO policy (vacation, sick leaves, and public holidays)
* Tech equipment provided

* Flexible hours & work setup

* You are a people-oriented team player that holds a proactive approach and ability to solve complex problems

* Test Automation experience, Scripting skills (preferably Robot Framework, Python etc.)
* Performance testing (Scalability, benchmarking, Load) frameworks, such as JMeter, etc.

* Jenkins CI

. At Helix, you’ll solve hard problems, build smart solutions, and work with people who challenge and champion you. You’ll see your ideas come to life—and your work make a difference.

title: Principal Test Engineer
description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

 

For more information, visit


www.sonicwall.com

or follow us on


X,


LinkedIn

,


Facebook

, and


Instagram

.

 

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a
**Principal Test Engineer (Test PE) / QA Lead**
to partner directly with the Sonicwall Firewall development team. In this high-impact technical role, you will lead feature testing, complex defect reproduction, test plan architecture, and automation development across critical Sonicwall Firewall networking and security components.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* ****Dev Partnership & Defect Triage:****
  Work closely with firmware and software developers to reproduce intricate customer and field issues, isolate root causes, and verify bug fixes.
* ****Test Strategy & Planning:****
  Architect end-to-end test strategies, author detailed test plans, and design comprehensive functional, system, and regression test suites.
* ****STLC & Quality Governance:****
  Drive the complete Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC)—identifying, filing, prioritizing, and tracking defects to closure in an Agile environment.
* ****Test Automation Engineering:****
  Develop, execute, and maintain automated test suites (functional, regression, and system) using Python to integrate into continuous testing pipelines.
* ****Component & Feature Qualification:****
  Deep-dive into Sonicwall Firewall  subsystems to validate new feature requirements, performance limits, and edge-case handling.
* ****Technical QA Mentorship:****
  Guide and mentor team members on test methodologies, test tool development, and network security validation.

**Core Skills & Requirements**

* ****Domain & SQA Experience:****
  10+ years of software quality assurance experience in the networking and network security domain for enterprise network products, appliances, or firewalls.

* ****Domain & Network Security Expertise:****

+ Deep understanding of L2–L7 networking concepts: TCP/IP, IP routing, NAT, VLANs, and stateful packet filtering.
+ Strong expertise in Network Security and Next-Generation Firewalling: Deep Packet Inspection (DPI), SSL/TLS, IPSec/SSL VPN, and access rules.

* ****Test Automation & Scripting:****

+ Strong hands-on programming/scripting proficiency in
  **Python**
  (OOP principles, test framework development, and REST API automation).
+ Experience utilizing traffic generators and test tools (e.g., IXIA, Spirent, Scapy, tcpreplay).

* ****Troubleshooting & Issue Reproduction:****

+ Advanced problem-solving skills with proven ability to capture and analyze network packets (Wireshark, tcpdump).
+ Experience analyzing system logs, core dumps, and device diagnostics to triage complex system/firmware behaviors.

* ****Methodologies & Processes:****

+ Thorough mastery of SDLC, STLC, defect lifecycles, and Agile/Scrum practices.
+ Experience designing system testbeds simulating enterprise network topologies.

* ****Professional Experience:****

+ 8+ years of test engineering and automation experience in the networking/network security domain (with a track record of driving test execution at a senior/lead/PE level).

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical mindset with high ownership of product quality and reliability.
* Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills to interface effectively with development, product management, and sustaining teams.
* Proven ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams.

SonicWall is an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.
  
  
At SonicWall, we pride ourselves on recruiting a diverse mix of talented people and providing active security solutions in 100+ countries.

Applicant Privacy Notice

title: Lead, Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Major Duties**

* Design, develop, and enhance scalable enterprise test automation frameworks for UI, API, integration, unit, regression, and end-to-end testing.
* Lead large-scale automated test execution across multiple applications and environments, including scheduled, release, deployment, and code-promotion validation.
* Improve test automation resiliency by identifying and eliminating flaky tests, intermittent failures, synchronization issues, dependency failures, test-data issues, environment instability, and configuration-related failures.
* Troubleshoot and fix, refactor, and optimize existing automation scripts, improving reliability, maintainability, execution speed, error handling, recovery, and reusability.
* Analyze execution failures to distinguish application defects from automation, environment, data, access, configuration, and infrastructure issues, and drive sustainable root-cause fixes.
* Build automation capable of reliable repeatable and unattended enterprise execution, with effective logging, reporting, failure diagnostics, rerun/recovery mechanisms, and execution monitoring.
* Validate code promotions, releases, deployments, and application/platform changes across development, test, staging, and production environments.
* Integrate automated testing and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines using Git, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or comparable technologies.
* Apply GitHub Copilot, Generative AI, and AI-assisted testing for test creation, code improvement, failure analysis, automation maintenance, and engineering productivity.
* Provide technical leadership through automation architecture, coding standards, code reviews, mentoring, and continuous improvement.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 10-13 years of relevant experience in Java test automation and SDLC release management, preferable in financial domain services.
* Strong expertise in DevOps.
* Holds Bachelor's or equivalent degree.

**Shift:**
APAC: 10:00AM to 7:00PM IST
  
  
**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Job Requisition for Executive Referrals only
description:
**Introduction**
India Systems Development Lab (ISDL)
  
  
IBM Systems division builds Servers, Storage and Systems Software which are the building blocks for next-generation IT infrastructure of enterprise customers and data centers. IBM Servers provide best-in-class reliability, scalability, performance, and end-to-end security to handle mission-critical workloads and provide seamless extension to hybrid multicloud environments.
  
  
India Systems Development Lab (ISDL) is part of word-wide IBM Systems division. Established in 1996, the ISDL Lab is headquartered in Bengaluru, with presence in Pune and Hyderabad as well. ISDL teams work across the IBM Systems stack including Processor development, Firmware, Operating Systems, Systems Software, Storage Software, Cloud Software, Performance Engineering, System Test etc. The ISDL teams also ushered in new development models such as Agile, Design Thinking and DevOps.
  
  
****Your Role And Responsibilities****
As a Software Engineer at IBM India Systems Development Lab (IBM ISDL), you will get an opportunity to work on all the phases of product development (Design/Development, Test and Support) across core Systems technologies including Operating Systems, Firmware, Systems Software, Storage Software & Cloud Software.
  
  
**As a Software Developer At ISDL:**

* You will be focused on development of IBM Systems products interfacing with development & product management teams and end users, cutting across Geos.
* You would analyze product requirements, determine the best course of design, implement/code the solution and test across the entire product development life cycle. One could also work on Validation and Support of IBM Systems products.
* You get to work with a vibrant, culture driven and technically accomplished teams working to create world-class products and deployment environments, delivering an industry leading user experience for our customers
* You will be valued for your contributions in a growing organization with broader opportunities.

At ISDL, work is more than a job - it's a calling: To build. To design. To code. To invent. To collaborate. To think along with clients. To make new products/markets. Not just to do something better, but to attempt things you've never thought was possible. Are you ready to lead in this new era of technology and solve some of the most challenging problems in Systems Software technologies? If so, let's talk.
  
  
Regular Job opportunities across ISDL teams are in the following areas.
  
  
Systems and Cloud Software Engineer: As a Software Engineer with IBM Systems and Cloud Software teams, you will get the opportunity to get involved in all the phases of software development and work with technically accomplished teams. The responsibilities comprise of design new enhancements, coding (including test automation), problem determination and bug fixing, performance analysis, and solving client problems. You could also work on IBM Compute and Storage Systems including Virtualisation, I/O and Reliability Availability & Serviceability thereby, enabling the creation of a seamless software user experience across the stack delivering to IBM's Hybrid Cloud and AI clients. As an engineer you will be responsible for enhancing and maintaining the key components of the Software stack, Platform enablement and an opportunity to work on closed and Open source development communities.
  
  
AI Software Engineer: As a Software Engineer with IBM AI on Z Solutions teams, you will get the opportunity to get involved in delivering best-in class Enterprise AI Solutions on IBM Z and support IBM Customers while adopting AI technologies / Solutions into their businesses by building ethical, secure, trustworthy and sustainable AI solutions on IBM Z.You will be part of end to end solutions working along with technically accomplished teams. You will be working as a Full stack developer starting from understanding client challenges to providing solutions using AI.
  
  
**IBM Spectrum Fusion SW Engineer:**
IBM Spectrum Fusion container-native storage solution for OpenShift is designed for enterprise customers who need global hybrid cloud data access. As a Software Engineer with IBM Storage Spectrum Fusion team, you will work with the Dev/Test team to develop and support features for Spectrum Fusion product roadmap.
  
  
**Linux Developer:**
As a Linux developer, you would be involved in design and development of advanced features in the Linux OS for the next generation server platforms from IBM by collaboration with the Linux community. You collaborate with teams across the hardware, firmware, and upstream Linux kernel community to deliver these capabilities.
  
  
**Hardware Management Console (HMC) / Novalink Software Developer:**
As a Software Developer in HMC / Novalink team, you will work on design, development, and test of the Management Console for IBM Power Servers. You will be involved in user centric Graphical User Interface development and Backend for server and virtualization management solution development in Agile environment.
  
  
**AIX Developer:**
AIX is a proprietary Unix operating system which runs on IBM Power Servers. It's a secure, scalable, and robust open standards-based UNIX operating system which is designed to meet the needs of Enterprises class infrastructure. title: Sr. Software Test Automation Engineer – Playwright with TypeScript and Agentic AI
description:
**About The Role**
As a Senior Software Test Automation Engineer, you will design, develop, and evolve modern test automation solutions that improve software quality, engineering velocity, and test coverage. This is a highly hands-on engineering role focused on Playwright, TypeScript, API automation, CI/CD, and AI-enabled quality engineering.
  
  
You will work closely with software engineers, product teams, and QE leaders to build scalable, maintainable automation and embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle. You will also explore and apply Agentic AI, LLM-based testing, AI-assisted test generation, self-healing automation, and intelligent test analysis to modernize traditional quality engineering practices.
  
  
The successful candidate is a strong software engineer who understands testing deeply and can translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, reliable QE solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable UI and API automation frameworks using Playwright and TypeScript.
* Develop robust automated tests covering functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end scenarios.
* Define and implement automation architecture, coding standards, reusable components, and testing patterns.
* Partner with developers and product teams to establish testability, acceptance criteria, and automation strategy early in the development lifecycle.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and enable reliable, repeatable execution.
* Analyze automation failures, identify root causes, and improve test reliability and maintainability.
* Reduce flaky tests through effective synchronization, resilient locators, test isolation, test data management, and failure diagnostics.
* Develop reusable automation utilities, libraries, skills, and tools that can be leveraged across teams and applications.
* Apply Agentic AI and LLM capabilities to areas such as automated test generation, test case optimization and coverage analysis, AI-assisted test maintenance, self-healing or resilient automation, failure analysis and root-cause identification, test data generation, requirements-to-test traceability, intelligent regression selection, and LLM/AI application testing and evaluation.
* Explore and implement AI agents, MCP-based integrations, and AI-assisted QE workflows where they provide measurable value.
* Develop or contribute to evaluation strategies for AI-powered applications, including LLM response validation, hallucination detection, prompt evaluation, rubrics, golden datasets, and quality metrics.
* Participate in architecture and code reviews and provide technical guidance on automation best practices.
* Troubleshoot complex automation, environment, test-data, and integration issues.
* Contribute to performance, reliability, and scalability testing as needed.
* Monitor automation effectiveness using metrics such as coverage, execution time, stability, defect detection, and maintenance effort.
* Mentor other engineers and promote modern automation and quality engineering practices.
* Continuously evaluate emerging testing technologies and AI capabilities and identify opportunities to improve QE productivity and quality.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of software test automation or quality engineering experience, with strong hands-on engineering experience.
* Strong hands-on experience with Playwright.
* Strong programming experience with TypeScript and/or JavaScript.
* Strong understanding of UI, API, integration, and end-to-end automation.
* Experience designing or contributing to test automation frameworks and architecture.
* Strong understanding of software development practices, Git, code reviews, debugging, and CI/CD.
* Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitLab.
* Experience with API testing and tools/frameworks such as REST, Postman, Playwright API, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of test design techniques, test strategy, test coverage, and risk-based testing.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex automation failures and identify root causes.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum software development environments.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Agentic AI / AI Testing Experience
  
  

* Generative AI / LLM application testing
* AI-assisted software development or test automation
* AI agents / Agentic AI workflows
* MCP or similar agent-to-tool integration frameworks
* AI-generated test cases or test scripts
* LLM evaluation and testing
* Prompt engineering and prompt evaluation
* RAG testing and evaluation
* Hallucination and factuality testing
* Golden datasets and evaluation datasets
* Rubric-based evaluation
* AI-powered test maintenance or self-healing automation
* AI-based failure analysis or test-result summarization
* Experience using tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI coding/testing assistants

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience with Playwright using TypeScript at enterprise scale.
* Experience migrating automation from Selenium to Playwright.
* Experience with BDD/Gherkin and translating requirements or acceptance criteria into automated tests.
* Experience with API automation and contract testing.
* Experience with performance/load testing tools such as JMeter, k6, or equivalent.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud-based test environments.
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or other cloud platforms.
* Experience with test management and defect tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, qTest, or equivalent.
* Experience building reusable internal automation libraries, tools, AI agents, or developer/QE skills.
* Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or LLM application architectures.
* Experience establishing quality metrics and automation effectiveness measures.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Build production-quality Playwright/TypeScript automation, not simply execute or maintain existing scripts.
* Increase automation coverage while reducing manual regression effort.
* Build automation that is stable, maintainable, scalable, and CI/CD ready.
* Reduce flaky-test rates and improve failure diagnostics.
* Identify opportunities where AI/Agentic AI can eliminate repetitive QE work.
* Create reusable automation components and AI-enabled capabilities that can be adopted by other QE teams.
* Collaborate directly with developers to identify and prevent quality issues earlier in the SDLC.
* Demonstrate measurable improvements in automation coverage, execution speed, reliability, defect detection, and QE productivity.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Hands-on engineering mindset
* Automation architecture
* Strong coding and debugging
* Problem solving
* Quality engineering mindset
* AI/Agentic AI curiosity and experimentation
* Continuous improvement
* Technical leadership
* Collaboration and communication
* Ability to work independently with minimal guidance

Position Emphasis
  
  
This is a hands-on Senior QE/Automation Engineering role, not primarily a test execution or test management position. The candidate should be comfortable writing production-quality TypeScript, developing Playwright automation, debugging code, designing automation architecture, and experimenting with AI-enabled QE solutions.
  
  
Our Interview Practices
  
  
*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*
*Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.*

title: Lead QA – Release & Automation
description:
**Lead QA – Release & Automation**

**About Williams-Sonoma, Inc.**

Founded in 1956 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500, digital first, multi-channel specialty retailer. Our company vision is to own the home, and the places where our customers work, stay, and play. We bring the latest home furnishing trends to life for customers through the individual lenses of our ten distinct brands, each serving different life stages and rooms of the home and beyond. Our brands include Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark & Graham, GreenRow, and Dormify. We are committed to sustainability, continuously working to protect our planet, while building an open and collaborative culture across our organization.

With more than 500 retail stores globally and multiple international franchise operations, technology is a core driver of our business strategy. We build and operate in-house platforms powering e-commerce, supply chain, merchandising, analytics, and customer experience ecosystems worldwide.

Engineers at the Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center build and scale digital commerce platforms that power these global brands, serving millions of customers worldwide.

**Role Overview**

Williams-Sonoma is seeking a Lead QA – Release & Automation to lead end-to-end mobile QA activities across iOS and Android releases, with strong hands-on experience in mobile testing and automation.

This role will own QA release sign-off, coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders, drive release regression, and continuously improve QA processes through automation and AI-enabled testing. Exposure to Web, API, and Microservices testing will be an added advantage.

The ideal candidate will help accelerate release velocity while ensuring high quality across multiple engineering teams contributing to shared releases.

**Impact of the Role**

• Accelerate release velocity while ensuring high quality across multiple engineering teams contributing to shared releases.

• Improve QA processes through automation and AI-enabled testing.

• Reduce release timelines and improve deployment frequency through optimized QA validation and regression processes.

• Drive continuous improvements in automation coverage, pipeline health, defect leakage, and release readiness.

Technology Platforms You Will Work On

• iOS and Android mobile applications

• Mobile automation frameworks such as Appium or equivalent tools

• Mabl, Selenium, and Playwright

• Web, API, and Microservices testing

• CI/CD platforms including Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms

• AI-powered testing solutions, AI-assisted test generation, self-healing automation, and intelligent test selection

**Key Responsibilities**

• Own end-to-end QA release sign-off for mobile applications across iOS and Android.

• Lead release regression testing and ensure production readiness across multiple engineering teams.

• Partner with Engineering, Product, DevOps, Release Management, and Vendor QA teams to plan, coordinate, and execute successful releases.

• Define and standardize QA release processes, quality gates, and release sign-off criteria.

• Drive mobile automation strategy across iOS and Android to maximize automation coverage and reduce manual regression effort.

• Ensure automation suites are stable, maintain high pipeline pass rates, minimize flaky tests, and support reliable CI/CD execution.

• Continuously optimize QA validation and regression processes to reduce release timelines and improve deployment frequency.

• Champion AI-powered testing solutions, AI-assisted test generation, self-healing automation, and intelligent test selection.

• Monitor QA metrics such as automation coverage, execution success rate, pipeline health, defect leakage, and release readiness, driving continuous improvements.

• Coordinate with multiple engineering teams to streamline testing activities and remove bottlenecks in the release process.

• Mentor QA engineers and promote best practices in automation, quality engineering, and release management.

**Qualifications**

• 10–12+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, QA Automation, or Release QA for enterprise applications, including 4+ years of hands-on mobile testing and automation experience.

• 3+ years of experience leading QA release management or centralized regression testing teams.

• Must have strong experience in Mobile QA across iOS and Android, including functional, regression, release, and automation testing.

• Must have hands-on experience with mobile automation frameworks such as Appium or equivalent mobile automation tools.

• Exposure to Mabl, Selenium, Playwright, Web testing, and API testing is good to have.

• Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.

• Experience working in Agile environments with multiple teams contributing to shared releases.

• Must have a strong understanding of release management, quality governance, and regression optimization.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in large-scale retail/eCommerce organizations.

• Experience leading QA transformation initiatives.

• Exposure to Web and API testing.

• Experience leveraging AI-enabled testing to accelerate software delivery.

**Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center**

• Our people first and performance driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career and invest in the well-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family.

• Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high-ownership that empowers engineers to make real impact.

• Build and operate large-scale digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale.

• Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and large-scale engineering challenges.

• Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with two in-office days for team engagement.

: 3-7 Years

**Work Preference**
: Onsite

**Work Location:**
Pune, MH

We are seeking a hands-on Firmware Design Engineer with 3-7 years of experience to implement, integrate, verify, and support embedded firmware for Client's fire and life-safety portfolio. The role supports new product development, product enhancements, platform updates, value engineering, component changes, compliance, and production support. Working with the Firmware Engineering Manager and experienced engineers, the candidate will own defined modules or features, develop drivers and product logic, support hardware bring-up, investigate defects, execute tests, and maintain controlled technical records. Assignments may include new implementations, legacy-code improvements, hardware or toolchain migrations, and changes driven by quality, cost, availability, or field performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Firmware Development and Implementation**

• Implement firmware work packages for new products, product enhancements, redesigns, sustenance, and value-engineering initiatives.

• Review software requirements, hardware interfaces, schematics, datasheets, existing source code, product documentation, and test procedures for assigned work.

• Develop or update startup, BSP, HAL, and driver modules for GPIO, timers, interrupts, ADC, PWM, serial interfaces, flash, non-volatile memory, watchdogs, and debug functions.

• Implement application logic for control, communication, indication, relays, supervised I/O, configuration, diagnostics, trouble reporting, and power-state behaviour as required.

• Maintain clear separation between reusable platform software and product configuration to reduce duplication and simplify regression.

• Support microcontroller, compiler, IDE, or hardware-platform migrations when included in an assigned project.

Integration Debugging and Verification

• Support board bring-up, peripheral validation, signal-level debugging, and hardware-firmware fault isolation with hardware engineers.

• Create and execute unit, module, integration, protocol, timing, fault-injection, regression, and system-integration tests for assigned features.

• Reproduce defects, collect logs and measurements, identify root cause, implement corrections, and verify that changes do not disturb existing behaviour.

• Use embedded IDEs, compilers, debuggers, JTAG or SWD probes, oscilloscopes, logic analysers, serial terminals, and protocol tools during implementation and debugging.

• Maintain requirements traceability, design notes, code-review records, test results, defect status, and release documentation for completed work.

**Product Lifecycle Compliance and Release Support**

• Implement firmware changes required by alternate components, hardware revisions, calibration updates, performance improvements, and cost-down initiatives.

• Support controlled test firmware and operating modes for transient, EMC, UL, FM, FCC, and other applicable compliance or certification testing.

• Prepare reproducible builds, binaries, maps, checksums, release notes, and configuration records and support production programming, ICT or FCT, pilot builds, and phase-in.

• Assist with production and field issue investigation and document corrective actions and regression evidence.

**Team Collaboration**

• Work with firmware, hardware, validation, compliance, manufacturing, product, and Client's US stakeholders to complete assigned work.

• Participate in design and code reviews, raise unclear requirements and technical risks early, and close assigned actions with objective evidence.

• Contribute reusable drivers, diagnostic utilities, test tools, documentation, and lessons learned for future development work.

**Qualifications**

• 3-7 years of hands-on embedded firmware-development experience, including coding, hardware integration, debugging, testing, and controlled release support.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Telecommunication, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related discipline.

• Strong Embedded C fundamentals and practical experience with microcontrollers, interrupts, timers, GPIO, ADC, serial communications, watchdogs, and non-volatile memory.

• Experience with bare-metal or RTOS-based embedded systems, modular drivers, state machines, error handling, and resource-constrained products.

• Ability to read schematics, datasheets, interface specifications, existing source code, system requirements, and test procedures and convert them into working firmware.

• Hands-on experience with embedded IDEs, compilers, debuggers, JTAG or SWD, common laboratory tools, version control, and defect tracking.

• A disciplined approach to coding, peer review, test evidence, root-cause analysis, regression testing, configuration management, and documentation.

**Preferred Experience**

• Prior experience with fire alarm, fire and life-safety, emergency communication, building-automation, or another regulated embedded product is strongly preferred.

• Participation in UL and FCC compliance or certification programs is strongly preferred; exposure to UL 864 or FM Approvals is an advantage.

• Experience with Renesas or similar microcontrollers, IAR or comparable toolchains, processor migration, or legacy-code modernisation is preferred.

• Exposure to fire-alarm communication loops, notification circuits, RS-485 or proprietary protocols, supervised I/O, annunciation, relay control, or networked power products is advantageous.

**Core Competencies**

Ownership Mindset | Embedded C | Firmware Implementation | MCU Peripherals | Hardware Debugging | Test Discipline | Product Lifecycle | Root-Cause Analysis | Documentation | Collaboration
