title: Specialist - Embedded Firmware
description:
**What You’ll Do**
The Specialist Embedded Software Engineer will be a critical member of the Power Systems Division’s team and will provide strong technical leadership in driving on time and on quality execution of new product development for the division's real-time controls and protective relays portfolio. The person will also work closely with global engineering leadership team and central platform teams to develop embedded software/firmware platforms, Model Based Development methodologies, drive adoption of AI tools for productivity, and software process excellence.
  
  

* Act as a technical lead and drive the design and implementation of embedded platform features for power system intelligent electronic devices, analyzing and delivering features with new and existing technologies, in line with the technological roadmap
* Evaluate system performance requirements and model future requirements to evaluate suitability of firmware and hardware components and to identify and mitigate risks.
* Drive technical architecture decisions to align with product requirements and platform strategy.
* Stage work and delegate appropriate aspects of design and implementation to other developers, ensuring compliance with architecture and system/design requirements.
* Contribute to strategic embedded system platform evaluations, while demonstrating a strong product and technology lifecycle understanding.
* Analyze technology, product and development team needs to mitigate risks and to accelerate delivery of products/features.
* Create optimized and right-sized solutions that meet or exceed product requirements with appropriate technical tradeoffs for constrained resources and serve as embedded software expert in the area of specifications, design, construction, test, test automation and maintenance
* Lead and guide complex system interface design activities and lead the resolution of integration issues across multiple engineering disciplines
* Collaborate with product owners, functional managers, systems engineering to distill and develop product/system/design requirements, use cases, identifying & mitigating risks, sizing effort, staging work and creating design paths/designs.
* Collaborate with Product Line Managers to analyze competitor product landscape and contribute with technology solutions for product differentiation and technology and product roadmaps.
* Demonstrate technical leadership level contributions with Linux based embedded systems as well as coach and mentor other team members with respect to technology, architecture, design principles, and coding practices to achieve functional and project goals.
* Collaborate with internal CoE's and external resources to select appropriate platforms, technologies, tools, problem solve accelerating new features/products.
* Demonstrate fluency and awareness of open-source software and understand best practices around integrating open-source software into commercial products
* Identify, investigate, leverage and deploy new technologies to enhance product features, improve quality/efficiency/collaboration.
* Contribute to DevOps activities for embedded platforms by designing and maintaining Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery pipelines.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s/Master's degree in Computer Science /Electronics/Electrical Engineering
* 14-18 years

**Skills**

* Embedded Linux, C++, OOPS, SOLID, Design Patterns, Unit Testing
* Demonstrated competency with hardware drivers, embedded applications, multi-core systems, networking and related areas primarily using C and C++ as programming languages.
* Demonstrated competency with embedded software development environments and tools for Embedded Linux.
* Demonstrated competency using or designing systems that use network protocols such as Serial, TCP/IP, Ethernet
* Demonstrated competencies creating and implementing virtualized environments for embedded software designs.
* Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Design (OOD) principles using C++, secure coding and cybersecurity best practices
* Demonstrated experience modelling real-time systems behavior and developing use cases using UML or similar methodologies as appropriate.
* Ability to work effectively in an Agile Scrum (or other iterative development) environment
* Experience with test-driven development (TDD) and unit test frameworks.
* Experience using SDLC management tools in a team environment (e.g. Jira, Confluence, Git, etc.)
* Debugging experience - Like J-Link debugger with IAR ARM for NXP ColdFire, STM32 or TI AM64x
* Experience with Industrial Communication Protocols (ModBus TCP/IP, CAN, USB, RS232/485, SPI, I2C, SNMP).
* Experience with Peripherals (DMA, LCD, FLASH, RAM, ADC, DAC, PWM, voltage/current/temp sensors).
* Ability to read schematics and interpret the behavior of electronic systems.
* Familiar with BlackDuck, Coverity tools
* Familiar with the following concepts - MQTT, TRAP,SNMP,SSL certificate, Boot loader, SYSLOG, Serial, Telnet, HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, FTPs, TLS,Free RADIUS, OpenLDAP and data encryption/decryption
* Familiar with JavaScript and Python
* Experience leading technical resources.

* 10 - 15 years of experience in testing & troubleshooting Cloud technologies, virtualization, Microservices, and debugging complex software
* Good experience in working with Hadoop & Big data technologies like HDFS, HBase, Spark, Kafka streaming, and Elasticsearch
* Good working knowledge of Database (SQL) and Server side validations.

* Strong knowledge of Linux systems.
* Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python will be a plus.
* Excellent written and oral English communication skills.
* Adaptive to learning new things and technologies

This role offers a unique opportunity to become a key technology partner for our global laboratory and quality functions, helping ensure that critical systems are reliable, compliant, efficient, and aligned with Envalior's business ambitions.
  
  
**The Role**
As a
**Solution Engineer – Quality, Laboratory & OT Systems**

**Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS)**
.
  
  
LIMS applications sit at the heart of Envalior's quality and laboratory operations. They support the management of laboratory samples, testing workflows, quality data, product specifications, and batch release activities across manufacturing and R&D environments. As the system owner and technical lead, you will ensure these platforms continue to deliver business value while supporting operational excellence and continuous improvement.
  
  
You will work closely with Quality, R&T, Operations, Manufacturing, Digital Solutions Delivery, and Technology Services teams worldwide to support existing solutions while identifying opportunities for innovation, automation, and simplification.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Own and Support Critical Laboratory & Quality Systems**

* Manage the lifecycle of laboratory and quality applications, including enhancements, upgrades, integrations, and support activities.
* Ensure platforms remain secure, stable, and aligned with evolving business requirements.

**Partner with the Business**

* Translate business challenges into scalable digital solutions.
* Build strong relationships with stakeholders and effectively communicate the value of technology-enabled change.

**Drive Innovation and Digital Transformation**

* Propose innovative information solutions by combining existing systems with emerging digital technologies.
* Evaluate opportunities to improve laboratory efficiency, data management, automation, and operational performance.
* Simplify and modernize existing application landscapes.
* Eliminate waste, reduce complexity, and improve user experience through technology and process optimization.

**Enable Reliable Laboratory Operations**

* Support systems used for sample management, laboratory workflows, testing activities, and quality data management.
* Ensure effective system integrations between laboratory, manufacturing, and enterprise platforms.
* Help maintain accurate, timely, and accessible laboratory information across the value chain.
* Support the digital backbone that enables quality decision-making and product release activities.

**Lead Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to strengthen system performance and business processes.
* Promote best practices in application management, information architecture, and digital solutions.
* Support change management initiatives and user adoption activities.
* Drive a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement across supported domains.

**Requirements**
**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* Experience in application management, solution engineering, business analysis, or related digital roles.
* Experience supporting Quality, Manufacturing, Laboratory, R&T, or Operational Technology environments.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience working within global and cross-functional organizations.
* Demonstrated ability to lead change and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

**Preferred Technical Expertise -**
**Laboratory & Quality Systems**

* ZhuoMES
* GUSLAB / LABSQ
* Unilab
* Thermo Fisher SampleManager LIMS
* WinLIMS

**OT & Manufacturing Solutions**

* Eschbach Shiftconnector
* AssetWise

**Sustainability & Quality Platforms**

* Credit360
* Other Quality, OT, and R&T SaaS applications

**Additional Capabilities**

* Information architecture (data, process, and application landscape)
* Application lifecycle management
* Systems integration and interfacing
* Change management
* Technical project delivery
* Analytical problem solving
* Operations, Quality, and R&T process knowledge

**What Success Looks Like**
In this role, you will become the trusted digital partner for Envalior's Quality and Laboratory community. You will ensure our LIMS landscape delivers reliable support to laboratories worldwide while helping the business embrace new technologies and more efficient ways of working.
  
  
**You Will Be Successful If You Can**

* Balance technology expertise with business understanding.
* Influence stakeholders through collaboration and credibility.
* Simplify complex challenges into practical solutions.
* Drive operational efficiency through digital innovation.
* Continuously improve the applications and processes that support Envalior's quality and laboratory operations.

**Benefits**
**Competitive Compensation**
Join us at Envalior and enjoy competitive compensation packages, inclusive of a global bonus program and individual performance bonuses, ensuring your hard work is recognized and rewarded.
  
  
**Comprehensive Benefits**
Your well-being matters to us. At Envalior, we provide an array of benefits supporting your financial security, health, and overall well-being. This includes retirement plans, health programs, life insurance, and comprehensive medical care.
  
  
**Work-Life Balance & Flexibility**
Maintain a healthy balance between work and personal life with Envalior's commitment to supporting your schedule.
  
  
**Training & Development Opportunities**
At Envalior, your growth matters. We encourage and invest in your professional and personal development. We support our employees in their growth and personal development through ongoing investment in their knowledge and skills via training, coaching, and mentoring.
  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion**
At Envalior, our people drive our success, so it’s only right that we provide a diverse and inclusive working environment and foster a culture of belonging, openness, and respect. We value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We are committed to nurturing and empowering every individual to reach their full potential.
  
  
**APPLY NOW!**
Ready to pioneer change with Envalior? Join us in our mission to drive innovation, sustainability, and excellence. Apply today and become a part of our transformative journey towards a more sustainable future.
  
  
Submit your application online by sending your CV and motivation letter in English through our career portal. If you have any questions, feel free to connect directly with our recruiter at Deepanshu.Tripathi@envalior.com

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Blitzy is a Cambridge, MA based AI software development platform on a mission to revolutionize the software development life cycle by autonomously building custom software to unlock the next industrial revolution. We're transforming how enterprises build software, turning enterprise requirements into enterprise grade code with an agentic software development platform that can autonomously execute 80% of the quantum of software development work. We're backed by multiple tier 1 investors, and have proven success as founders of previous start-ups.
  
  
**Our Culture**
**Who We Are**
Led by two pioneering co-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U.S., creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500.
  
  
**How We Work**

* We move Blitzy Fast: Time is both our company’s and our clients’ most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally.
* Championship Mindset: We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in-person, and remaining focused on the mission.
* Passion for Invention: We’re pushing the frontier of what’s possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration.
* We Work for the Customer: We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships.

**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Pune HQ2 team and work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and complex enterprise software. You’ll embed with customer engineering teams and help them transform how they build software with Blitzy. This isn’t a hand-coding or traditional solutions engineering role. You’ll onboard new teams, guide them through the platform, troubleshoot issues, and work with client engineers on architecture and priorities, with the goal of getting each team to run Blitzy independently.
  
  
Our HQ2 FDE team deploys alongside customers around the world, working closely with US-based engineering and customer teams with regular time zone overlap for collaboration and handoffs. You’ll partner with customer stakeholders across regions and help each engagement run smoothly from kickoff to steady state.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deploy Blitzy into complex enterprise environments, navigating technical constraints and translating customer business goals into practical technical solutions
* Embed with customer teams during critical implementations, partnering with engineering leaders on sprint planning, architecture reviews, technical decisions, and production deployments
* Build production-quality integrations, services, and extensions using Java 17 and Spring Boot 3.x, including Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, and Actuator
* Build and evolve REST APIs using a contract-first approach with OpenAPI/Swagger, with data persistence through PostgreSQL, Hibernate/JPA, and Liquibase
* Package and deploy containerized services with Docker and manage dependencies through Maven, including BOMs and multi-module projects
* Develop custom solutions, reusable patterns, scripts, and tools that accelerate customer adoption and demonstrate Blitzy’s capabilities in enterprise environments
* Debug complex issues spanning customer infrastructure, integrations, microservices, and the Blitzy platform, supporting production operations, health checks, metrics, and configuration management
* Drive successful POCs and technical demonstrations that showcase advanced use cases, deliver measurable value, and expand into enterprise-wide deployments
* Maintain high standards for testing, code quality, performance, and observability using JUnit 5, Cucumber/Gherkin, JMeter, Git, Logback/SLF4J, SpotBugs, and SonarQube
* Identify recurring customer needs, technical patterns, and expansion opportunities that inform product priorities and enterprise adoption
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate field experience into platform improvements, technical documentation, reusable best practices, and contributions to the core product

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production code in enterprise environments
* Deep hands-on expertise with Java 17, Spring Boot 3.x, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, Hibernate/JPA, and Actuator
* Strong experience with REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, PostgreSQL, Liquibase, Maven, Docker, and modern testing practices including JUnit 5, Cucumber/Gherkin, and JMeter
* Experience building and operating microservices with CI/CD, cloud architecture, observability, production monitoring, and tools such as Micrometer, Dynatrace, SpotBugs, and SonarQube
* Knowledge of enterprise modernization and distributed systems, including Java 8 → Java 17 upgrades, monolith → microservices migrations, Kafka, Avro, Schema Registry, caching, and resilience patterns
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum and modern software development practices, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to audiences ranging from interns to CTOs
* Experience in customer-facing engineering, developer tools, AI/ML, or enterprise modernization is a plus, along with technical thought leadership through blogs, talks, or open-source contributions
* Passion for AI-powered software development and willingness to work in person from Pune, India, with overlap for US-based teams

*Blitzy is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe different perspectives make us stronger. Base salary ranges are determined by country, role, level, experience, and skills. The range displayed on each job posting reflects Blitzy’s good faith determination of the minimum and maximum targets for new hire salaries across all locations. Individual pay is determined by related factors, including job skills, experience, and relevant education or training, which may impact a final offer. Your Talent Partner can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process*

**Overview**
The SME team is looking for a Senior Software Integration Engineer who can contribute independently in complex situations while supporting quality, engineering, and delivery goals. This role requires strong experience in agile work management, integration testing, quality assurance, requirements management, SDLC practices, systems integration, troubleshooting, web services, workflow management, and test automation.
  
  
The ideal candidate will plan, prioritize, and manage work using agile practices to enable iterative delivery, collaboration, adaptability, and continuous improvement. They will partner with developers and engineering teams to review source code, identify issues, improve quality, and promote maintainability and coding standards.
  
  
This position is responsible for designing, executing, and maintaining tests that validate interactions across integrated components, systems, services, APIs, data flows, interfaces, and dependencies. The candidate will help establish and maintain QA processes and standards that prevent defects, optimize performance, improve customer satisfaction, and support compliance.
  
  
The role also requires strong understanding of requirements management, SDLC, systems integration, web services, troubleshooting, and workflow management. The candidate should be a key contributor who can guide others informally and help teams deliver reliable, maintainable solutions.
  
  
Role
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Perform QE activities across assigned projects, including test planning, strategy, validation, automation, and release readiness.
* Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to enhance testing processes and strengthen quality practices.
* Contribute to SME QE teams focused on test validation and automation within assigned projects.
* Design, execute, and maintain integration tests to validate interactions between systems, services, APIs, data flows, interfaces, and dependencies.
* Establish and maintain QA processes and standards that prevent defects, improve quality, optimize performance, and support customer expectations.
* Apply agile work management practices to plan, prioritize, and manage work effectively in iterative delivery environments.
* Partner with product owners, developers, and delivery teams to review requirements, clarify acceptance criteria, manage changes, identify risks, and ensure testability throughout the SDLC.
* Support SDLC activities including requirements, design, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance to ensure solutions remain high quality and maintainable.
* Contribute to systems integration by validating communication, interoperability, and reliability across diverse technologies, processes, applications, and services.
* Implement and support UI, API, backend, and integration automation using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, and API automation frameworks.
* Support API performance testing and performance validation using tools such as Gatling and BlazeMeter.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across systems, applications, services, integrations, test environments, and networks using structured methods and tools.
* Evaluate source code written by developers to identify and address potential issues, support maintainability, improve quality, and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.
* Analyze workflows, identify bottlenecks, streamline procedures, monitor progress, allocate resources, and adapt processes to ensure work moves smoothly from one stage to the next.
* Contribute to CI/CD and DevOps practices by supporting automated test execution, version control, and integration of test automation into delivery pipelines.
* Provide technical guidance to team members, support proof-of-concepts, coach others informally, and help teams adopt scalable and maintainable test automation practices.
* Communicate status, risks, dependencies, and quality insights clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
* Promote agile ways of working, continuous learning, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across the team.

**All About You / Experience**
The ideal candidate for this position should have:
  
  

* Strong experience in quality engineering, test strategy, planning, automation, QA, and software validation across complex technology programs.
* Ability to apply skills independently and consistently in complex or nuanced situations while supporting broader business, delivery, and quality goals.
* Strong knowledge of agile principles and practices, including planning, prioritization, iterative delivery, collaboration, adaptability, and continuous improvement.
* Experience collaborating with developers and engineering teams to review source code, identify potential issues, improve maintainability, and promote coding standards and best practices.
* Hands-on experience with UI and API automation tools such as Playwright and Cypress.
* Strong experience in API integration testing and backend validation.
* Experience designing and maintaining integration tests that validate data flows, interfaces, dependencies, web services, and system interactions.
* Experience with API performance testing and exposure to performance testing tools such as Gatling and BlazeMeter.
* Strong understanding of requirements management, including documenting, analyzing, tracing, prioritizing, agreeing on, and communicating requirements and changes to stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of software development life cycle practices, including requirements gathering, design, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
* Experience with systems integration, including validating communication and interoperability across applications, services, technologies, and processes.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to systematically identify, diagnose, and resolve technical issues across systems, applications, services, test environments, and networks.
* Experience with web services and standardized protocols that enable communication, data exchange, interoperability, scalability, and integration across diverse systems.
* Ability to analyze workflows, identify bottlenecks, streamline procedures, monitor progress, allocate resources, and adapt processes to achieve outcomes.
* Working knowledge of version control tools such as Git.
* Experience with API testing tools such as Insomnia.
* Experience with test case management tools such as XRay.
* Experience with project management tools such as Jira.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, preferably Azure.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering and quality practices, including GitHub Copilot, Playwright MCP servers, and automation accelerators.
* Ability to work on proof-of-concepts.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and present quality insights clearly.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Principal Silicon Validation Engineer
description:
**Description**
**Invent the future with us.**
Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute.
  
  
As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications.
  
  
Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we’d love to have you apply!
  
  
**About The Role**
This position is for a Principal Silicon Validation Engineer within the Silicon Validation Engineering team, supporting Ampere’s AI Compute family. The engineer will test, qualify, and improve bare-metal validation framework used for CPU/Mesh, SoC, and platform validation across emulation and post-silicon environments.
  
  
The role owns regression strategy, test automation, CI/CD integration, results analysis, and first-level failure triage. The engineer will ensure validation processes, traceability, documentation, and test evidence meet strict ISO 26262 functional-safety and high-quality engineering requirements up to ASIL-D, where applicable
  
  
**What You'll Achieve**

* Develop test plans, automated regression suites, and validation strategies for the bare-metal framework.
* Create and execute functional, negative, stress, robustness, fault-injection, and regression tests across simulation, emulation, FPGA, and post-silicon environments.
* Validate framework execution, build/load/boot flows, CPU and memory features, interrupts, timers, coherency, power/reset, error handling, recovery, and multicore configurations.
* Own regression execution, monitoring, metrics, CI/CD pipelines, test artifacts, and reporting.
* Perform first-level triage; reproduce and classify failures across test, framework, firmware, hardware, configuration, and lab infrastructure.
* Develop automation for test execution, log collection, result analysis, failure classification, and reporting.
* Maintain reproducible test configurations, tool versions, artifacts, requirements traceability, and objective verification evidence.
* Support ISO 26262-aligned requirements-based testing, safety-mechanism validation, fault handling, diagnostic testing, and review/audit readiness up to ASIL-D.
* Improve logging, diagnostics, assertions, timeouts, health checks, and failure signatures; identify and resolve flaky tests.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams on testability, debug, framework improvements, defect resolution, and platform bring-up

**About You**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* 8+ years of experience in validation, test automation, firmware/system testing, or functional safety
* Strong experience in validation, test automation, firmware/system testing, or hardware/software integration.
* Strong Python, C, or C++ programming, scripting, and AI Coding skills.
* Experience building automated test infrastructure, regression suites, and CI/CD workflows.
* Experience with test planning, requirements-based testing, defect tracking, result analysis, and reporting.
* Experience with ISO 26262 or similar safety-critical standards; ASIL-D validation experience is strongly preferred.
* Understanding of traceability, configuration/change management, anomaly management, verification evidence, and safety-quality processes.
* Experience with Linux, Git, build systems, and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI or GitHub Actions.
* Familiarity with bare-metal software, firmware, boot flows, ARMv8/AArch64 or Cortex-M/R Series Controllers, and CPU/SoC concepts including caches, MMU, interrupts, timers, coherency, exceptions, reset, and power.
* Experience analyzing logs, firmware traces, register dumps, crashes, and test results.
* Familiarity with DSTREAM, Trace32, OpenOCD, GDB, JTAG, simulation, emulation, FPGA, post-silicon bring-up, or lab automation is a plus.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, communication, and systematic debugging skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with bare-metal test frameworks, CPU/Mesh/SoC validation, boot firmware, or post-silicon bring-up.
* Experience with safety mechanisms, fault injection, diagnostic coverage, safety evidence, assessments, or audits.
* Experience with requirements/test-management tools such as Jira, Polarion, Codebeamer, or TestRail.
* Experience owning hardware or firmware regression infrastructure and resolving flaky or intermittent failures.

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits.
  
  
**Benefits Highlights Include**

* Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work.
* Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
* Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day.

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are passionate about inventing industry leading cloud-native designs that contribute to a more sustainable future. title: Lead Test Automation Engineer
description:

* End-to-End System Integration Testing

+ Define and drive system integration test strategy covering hardware, firmware, software, communication interfaces, devices, APIs, and connected subsystems.

**Experience**

* Minimum 8+ years of experience Embedded Systems testing, quality assurance, and end-to-end System Integration Testing.
* Proven experience with Python, with Automation Frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of embedded systems testing, integration testing, subsystem validation, defect analysis, and release quality assurance.

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in developing automated test scripts using Python.
* Experience with embedded system development/testing tools, integration test benches, simulators, HIL/SIL environments, and debugging instruments.
* Familiarity with communication protocols (e.g., UART, SPI, I2C, CAN).
* Knowledge of version control systems (e.g., Git, BitBucket).
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and tools (e.g., Jenkins).

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to guide a testing team, work independently, collaborate across functions, and take ownership of technical quality deliverables.

* A challenging role focused on developing new systems with the help of advanced embedded technology.
* Global exposure and opportunities through internal mobility
* Freedom and authority to act

Hybrid

title: Senior QA Test Engineer GCC
description:
****Who is Litmus****
Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
  
  
AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
  
  
We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
  
  
Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.
  
  
****Why join Litmus****
****Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible****
AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
  
  
****Work on problems where software meets the real world****
Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.
  
  
****Have real impact, fast****
You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
  
  
****Join a high-performance team****
We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
  
  
****Our culture****
At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
  
  
We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are hiring Senior QA Automation Engineers to test our data cataloging and real-time data platform products. You will build reliable automation with Playwright, turn business and technical requirements into test cases, and work with developers and product owners to improve product quality.
  
  
We have openings in two areas: application and API automation for our data cataloging product, and end-to-end data validation for our real-time data platform. Your experience will help us identify the best fit. Both openings are hands-on automation roles.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Develop and maintain automated UI tests with Playwright, using TypeScript or JavaScript, and build supporting test scripts and tools in Python where appropriate.
* Translate functional and non-functional requirements into clear test cases and automated coverage.
* Investigate test failures, work with developers to identify root causes, and improve test coverage and automation efficiency.
* Use Linux, Git and AI tools as part of your testing and automation work.

Depending on your product assignment, you will also:
  
  

* Automate API tests, build and troubleshoot Docker test environments, and set up and maintain CI pipelines for application testing.
* Test data flows from source systems to downstream destinations, checking completeness, correctness and consistency, and build scripts to generate test data and validate results at scale.

**What You Will Bring**

* QA experience with a strong focus on hands-on test automation.
* Practical experience building and maintaining automated tests with Playwright.
* Automation coding skills in TypeScript, JavaScript or Python, with strong TypeScript or JavaScript skills for the application automation opening.
* Confidence working in the Linux command line, using Git, and turning requirements into effective test cases.
* Experience using AI tools to support testing and test automation.

**Additional Requirements By Opening**

* Application and API automation: API testing experience; hands-on Docker skills, including building images, running containers and debugging; and experience with CI/CD practices and setting up pipelines in Jenkins, Git-based tooling or similar.
* Real-time data testing: 3–6 years of QA experience, including hands-on validation of data from source to destination; working knowledge of SQL and JSON; and the ability to automate data checks using Python or TypeScript/JavaScript. Docker and Kubernetes can be learned on the job.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with data processing or cataloging products, industrial or IoT data, or MQTT, Kafka and other pub/sub messaging systems.
* Kubernetes, performance or load testing, and CI pipeline setup experience for the real-time data opening.

**In this role, you will:**
**(Principal Responsibilities)**

* Act as the senior technical lead for integration testing across the Product Control pod and Channels IT programme.
* Define and own the end-to-end integration-testing strategy across upstream, downstream, internal and third-party systems.
* Establish integration-test scope, environments, test data, dependencies, entry and exit criteria, quality gates and release-readiness measures.
* Lead testing across APIs, microservices, messaging platforms, event-driven services, data pipelines, databases and reporting interfaces.
* Ensure end-to-end business flows are validated across contact center, Product Control, accounting, regulatory and reconciliation processes.

* Identify and manage interface, environment, data, sequencing and dependency risks.
* Ensure defects are logged, prioritized, root causes are understood and remediation is tracked through to closure.
* Provide clear status reporting on integration coverage, risks, defects, dependencies and release readiness.

**NFR strategy and assurance**

* Define and maintain the NFR strategy, ensuring requirements are identified, measurable, testable and traceable to business and technical outcomes.
* Work with architects, engineers, infrastructure, security, operations and business stakeholders to establish NFR acceptance criteria.
* Lead the planning and execution of NFR testing, including:

+ Performance, load, stress and endurance testing
+ Scalability and capacity testing
+ Resilience, failover and recovery testing
+ Availability and service-continuity validation
+ Data quality, integrity and reconciliation testing
+ Security, access-control and vulnerability validation
+ Monitoring, alerting, logging and observability testing
+ Disaster-recovery and operational-readiness testing

title: MCU Networking & Diagnostics Engineer
description:
Role Purpose
  
  
Design, develop, integrate, and validate MCU-based automotive communication and diagnostic software, ensuring robust vehicle-network connectivity, standards-compliant diagnostics, reliable fault handling, and traceable delivery across ECU programs.
  
  
Main Responsibilities
  
  
Core duty description: Design and configure MCU communication stacks and develop diagnostic services for automotive applications.
  
  

* Design and configure MCU communication stacks for CAN, CAN FD, LIN, Ethernet, SOME/IP, and transport protocols based on project architecture.
* Develop and integrate diagnostic services using UDS, DoIP, OBD, DTC management, diagnostic sessions, security access, and routine control.
* Configure AUTOSAR communication and diagnostic modules, including COM, PduR, CanIf, CanTp, Dcm, Dem, NvM interfaces, and Ethernet-related services where applicable.
* Translate customer signal databases, diagnostic specifications, and network descriptions into maintainable software configurations and interface contracts.
* Implement network management, wake-up and sleep handling, communication control, timeout supervision, bus-off recovery, and degraded-mode behavior.
* Perform bench, SIL, HIL, and vehicle-level debugging using traces, bus logs, diagnostic logs, and MCU runtime measurements.
* Ensure bidirectional traceability from networking and diagnostic requirements through design, implementation, configuration, and verification evidence.
* Coordinate with system, BSW, application, validation, cybersecurity, and customer teams to resolve interface issues and deliver production-ready releases.

Key Requirements
  
  

* Strong embedded C development and debugging experience on automotive microcontrollers.
* Hands-on knowledge of CAN, CAN FD, LIN, Ethernet, SOME/IP, DoIP, UDS, ISO-TP, OBD, and vehicle network management concepts.
* Experience with AUTOSAR Classic communication and diagnostic BSW configuration, integration, and issue analysis.
* Ability to interpret DBC, ARXML, ODX, CDD, diagnostic extracts, signal matrices, and customer interface specifications.
* Proficiency with bus analyzers, debuggers, diagnostic testers, oscilloscopes, and log-analysis methods.
* Good understanding of ASPICE engineering practices, functional safety awareness, cybersecurity constraints, and disciplined defect resolution.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with Vector CANoe, CANalyzer, CANape, DaVinci Configurator/Developer, EB tresos, or equivalent automotive tools.
* Exposure to bootloaders, secure diagnostics, OTA or flash programming, Ethernet test tools, scripting, and test automation.

Other Details
  
  
Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Automotive Engineering, or a related discipline. Equivalent relevant industry experience may also be considered.
  
  
Expected leadership behaviors include owning networking and diagnostic delivery outcomes, promoting reusable configurations, and coaching engineers in protocol analysis and systematic debugging.

CSE SRE – DBA Focus

**Job Description**

As a Software Dev Senior Engineer, you will own the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of our Cloud-based services. You will define and enforce reliability standards, drive the adoption of SRE practices across engineering teams, and build the systems and tooling that keep our production infrastructure healthy. We follow a DevOps model: Development and Operations teams are integrated, and the SRE function acts as the reliability layer — setting Service Level Objectives, managing error alerts, and continuously reducing toil through engineering.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead on call response and triage – help design and lead the 24x7 response team for triage and rally engineering to address service degradation, facilitating process and communications along the way
* Define, publish, and continuously refine Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for all critical services, partnering with product and engineering leadership.
* Own the error management practices, including monitoring and alerting, and surfacing notable errors to the development team
* Lead the design and implementation of comprehensive observability platforms — metrics, structured logging, and distributed tracing — to ensure full visibility into production systems.
* Drive toil reduction initiatives by identifying and automating repetitive, manual operational work, targeting measurable reduction in operational burden across teams.
* Design and execute chaos engineering programs to proactively uncover reliability weaknesses in our infrastructure and services before they impact customers.

* Lead blameless postmortem culture: facilitate incident retrospectives, extract systemic learnings, and track corrective action items to completion.
* Build and improve on-call incident response processes, runbooks, and escalation paths; manage and optimize on-call rotation health to prevent burnout.
* Collaborate with platform and application developers to bring new features and services into production using production-readiness reviews and launch checklists.
* Champion reliability engineering best practices across the organization, embedding SRE principles into the software development lifecycle.
* Mentor team members on SRE philosophy, technical decision-making, code reviews, and cloud engineering best practices.
* Participate in roadmap planning, identify areas of improvement, and perform technology evaluation and selection.

**Required:**

* 5+ years of experience in database scaling performance and reliability, connection pool optimization
* 5+ years of experience in database HA design and failover strategies
* 3+ years of hands-on Site Reliability Engineering experience, including ownership of SLOs and error budget management.
* 4+ years of experience with Cloud Platforms, GCP CloudSQL required.
* Experience with database capacity planning, load testing, and performance benchmarking at scale.
* Experience managing other database systems — PostgreSQL, Redis, Etc .
* CS Degree or equivalent experience.

**Preferred:**

* Familiarity with Google SRE principles and the concepts outlined in the Google SRE Book
* Understanding of the HTTP protocol and experience diagnosing distributed system latency issues.
* Experience with instrumentation and management of automated deployments.
* Experience resolving customer-facing production issues under time pressure.
* Experience working with distributed, cross-functional teams
* Experience in infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CDK)
* Experience in scripting using Python, Shell, or a similar language.
* Experience with orchestration technologies, including Kubernetes.
* Understanding of networking, including routing, naming, security, network performance, and network failure modes.
* Experience designing and operating observability stacks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, or equivalent).
* Experience with incident management platforms and on-call tooling (e.g., PagerDuty, OpsGenie).

title: Engineer III - Cloud
description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
  
  
****About The Role:****
We're hiring a Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain SOAR connectors that integrate third-party security platforms with Falcon Fusion, and build/maintain platform services that provide core orchestration and workflow capabilities to all users of CrowdStrike's flagship Falcon Platform.
  
  
Falcon Fusion – a core 'tier one' offering in our Flagship Platform, Falcon – is used by customers to automate breach remediations within their environments. It also serves as the runtime for apps built by our Foundry Module and is 'dogfooded' internally to automate workflows and accelerate development. Processing anywhere from 500M to 10B+ events per day, it is utilized by essentially every customer of the Falcon Platform.
  
  
This role is for an experienced backend microservices developer adept with cloud engineering principles. Your passion and meticulous attention to performance, reliability, and scalability will be key ingredients to your success at CrowdStrike.
  
  
****What You'll Do:****

* Build production-grade SOAR connectors that integrate security platforms (SIEM, EDR, ticketing, IAM) with Falcon Fusion at scale, and contribute to core platform services powering connector execution, authentication, and orchestration.
* You'll own connectors end-to-end—from API research through deployment and production support—while improving underlying platform capabilities (auth systems, testing frameworks, deployment pipelines).
* Research, evaluate, and integrate new security platforms and APIs to expand our connector portfolio.
* Develop both connectors and platform services working with complex authentication mechanisms (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, API keys).
* Build and maintain automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines to ensure connector quality and reliability across multi-region deployments.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues with existing connectors and platform services, taking operational ownership across our fleet of Falcon environments.
* Write technical documentation including integration guides, API specifications, and troubleshooting runbooks.

****What You'll Need:****

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 6+ years of experience designing, implementing, and maintaining software systems across all phases of the development lifecycle, preferably in a SaaS model.
* Fluency in at least one programming language, preferably Python or Go.
* Proven expertise in building distributed systems, microservices, and REST APIs.
* Experience developing applications using SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Hands-on experience in large-scale system architecture, high scalability, availability, and optimization.
* Demonstrated track record of operational excellence when operating services that span many components across several geographical regions
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
* Strong communication skills with a track record of working collaboratively across stakeholders.

****Bonus Points:****

* Experience with commercial cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Contributions to open-source communities.
* Hands-on Golang experience.
* Prior experience with (cybersecurity) platforms or integrations.

****Benefits Of Working At CrowdStrike:****

* Market leader in compensation and equity awards
* Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
* Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
* Paid parental and adoption leaves
* Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role
* Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections
* Vibrant office culture with world class amenities
* Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where everyone is valued for who they are and empowered to succeed. We support veterans and individuals with disabilities through our affirmative action program.
  
  
CrowdStrike is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants for employment. title: QA AIML Consultant
description:
Job Description: AI SDET Engineer
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced AI Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to define and advance quality engineering across web, API, mobile, cloud, and AI-enabled products. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with deep test automation expertise and can validate both deterministic software and probabilistic AI behavior. This role partners closely with Engineering, Product, Design, SRE, Security, and Data/ML teams to build quality into the full delivery lifecycle, improve release confidence, and lead the evolution of our testing strategy, tooling, and people.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end quality strategy, including risk-based test planning, requirement traceability, coverage analysis, test matrices, release-readiness criteria, and production validation.
* Design and maintain scalable automation frameworks for UI, API, mobile, integration, and end-to-end testing using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, TestNG, and pytest.
* Establish maintainable test architecture through modular design, page or screen objects, reusable fixtures, parametrization, test-data management, and appropriate use of BDD, mocking, and stubbing.
* Define API and contract-testing practices for REST and GraphQL services using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or Karate, while promoting effective unit testing and close collaboration with developers.
* Automate test execution, reporting, quality gates, and deployment controls in Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps pipelines.
* Lead performance, load, reliability, resiliency, and security validation using tools such as k6, JMeter, or Gatling; incorporate chaos testing and OWASP-aligned security checks where appropriate.
* Use logs, traces, and metrics from platforms such as ELK, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, and Jaeger to diagnose failures, reproduce production issues, and drive root-cause analysis.
* Build automated evaluation harnesses and regression suites for machine-learning models, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation systems, and agentic workflows.
* Define quality KPIs and service expectations, including escape rate, flaky-test rate, automation effectiveness, mean time to detect, and release quality; communicate trends and corrective actions to stakeholders.
* Create effective defect triage and release-readiness processes, influence product and design decisions, and ensure quality risks are visible and acted upon.
* Protect personal and sensitive information through secure test-data generation, access controls, masking, redaction, retention practices, and GDPR/PII-aware validation.
* Mentor and lead QA and SDET engineers, contribute to hiring and onboarding, and strengthen engineering practices across distributed cross-functional teams.

**Core Qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or an SDET role, with evidence of ownership of complex quality initiatives.
* Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Java, C#, or JavaScript/TypeScript, supported by strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, networking, and operating-system fundamentals.
* Hands-on experience designing test frameworks and maintainable automation architecture with Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, TestNG, pytest, or comparable tools.
* Strong knowledge of test design techniques, risk-based testing, integration and end-to-end strategy, TDD/ATDD practices, requirement traceability, coverage analysis, and test-matrix management.
* Experience testing REST and GraphQL APIs and service contracts with Postman, REST Assured, Karate, or equivalent tooling; ability to use mocks and stubs to isolate dependencies.
* Practical experience with load and performance testing, reliability or chaos testing, security-testing fundamentals, and OWASP principles.
* Experience integrating automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines and working with Git, Docker, basic Kubernetes concepts, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.
* Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills using logs, distributed traces, metrics, and production observability platforms.
* Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, influence decisions, and partner effectively with Development, SRE, Product, Design, Security, and Data/ML teams.
* Experience working with quality KPIs and SLAs, supporting release-readiness assessments, and participating in defect triage.
* Working knowledge of GDPR and PII obligations, including secure test-data creation, masking, redaction, and least-privilege access.

AI Testing Expertise
  
  

* Experience testing non-deterministic AI systems and translating product expectations into measurable evaluation criteria, representative datasets, scoring rubrics, statistical thresholds, and repeatable acceptance gates.
* Ability to evaluate large language model quality across correctness, groundedness, faithfulness, relevance, completeness, consistency, latency, token usage, cost, and failure behavior rather than relying on exact-match assertions alone.
* Hands-on understanding of retrieval-augmented generation testing, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval recall and ranking, context relevance, citation accuracy, answer groundedness, and stale or conflicting knowledge.
* Experience building golden datasets and regression suites; curating, labeling, versioning, and reviewing evaluation data while preventing leakage, contamination, duplication, and unrepresentative test coverage.
* Knowledge of adversarial and safety testing for prompt injection, jailbreaks, indirect injection, sensitive-data disclosure, insecure tool use, hallucinations, harmful content, toxicity, bias, fairness, and model or agent misuse.
* Ability to test agentic and tool-calling workflows, including multi-step planning, permissions, memory and state, tool selection, retries, timeouts, partial failures, human approvals, and safe recovery.
* Experience validating model, prompt, retrieval, and configuration changes through versioned experiments, reproducible environments, baseline comparisons, confidence intervals, and controlled rollout or canary strategies.
* Understanding of model and data drift, feedback-loop risks, online quality monitoring, human-in-the-loop review, and production signals that detect degradation after release.
* Familiarity with AI evaluation and observability tools such as OpenAI Evals, promptfoo, Ragas, DeepEval, LangSmith, Langfuse, MLflow, Weights & Biases, or equivalent frameworks.
* Knowledge of AI-specific privacy and security risks, including training-data exposure, model inversion, membership inference, prompt and response logging, retention controls, and safe use of synthetic data.

Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Experience testing mobile, embedded, distributed, event-driven, or highly regulated systems.
* Experience with cloud-native testing on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud and with ephemeral test environments managed through Kubernetes and Terraform.
* Familiarity with MLOps practices, model registries, feature stores, data validation, experiment tracking, dataset or artifact versioning, and quality-engineering enablement or open-source tooling.

title: Software Solutions Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Software Solutions Engineer to support NVIDIA AI Enterprise customers and deployments across cloud and datacenter environments. This is a dual role: (1) Support, triage and resolve complex customer software issues end-to-end, and (2) build software features, automation, diagnostics, reproducible test cases, and deployment tooling—to improve product readiness and scale support across enterprise environments.
  
  
You will work across compute and cloud-native technologies in CSP environments, including container platforms/orchestrators, enterprise system software, and GPU-accelerated AI frameworks and inference services used to run production AI workloads at scale. In this customer-facing role, you will work closely with customers and internal engineering teams to understand issues, explain root causes, drive resolution, and collaborate on fixes and improvements. Success in this role requires strong debugging skills, crisp communication, and ownership of technically deep escalations from inception to closure.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Develop and maintain product-facing features and deployment assets for AI Enterprise supportability (e.g., scripts, configuration guidance, Kubernetes manifests/Helm charts, and reproducible test cases)
* Develop and maintain Python-based tooling/automation (validators, log collectors, repro harnesses) to improve NVIDIA AI Enterprise deployment reliability across NGC and container orchestrators (e.g., Kubernetes)
* Contribute code-level fixes, patches, or pull requests (as appropriate) in collaboration with engineering to address customer-impacting issues and improve product readiness
* Support enterprise customers deploying NVIDIA AI Enterprise in datacenter and CSP environments, including Kubernetes-based and containerized production AI platforms
* Take ownership of customer issues from inception to resolution: reproduce in lab/cloud, collect diagnostics, provide mitigations, and partner with engineering on fixes
* Create high-quality bug reports and RFEs with clear repro steps, environment details (CSP/Kubernetes/GPU), impact analysis, and supporting artifacts
* Develop customer-facing and internal documentation (KBs, runbooks, deployment guidance) to improve time-to-value and reduce recurring issues
* Be on call one weekend per month in the event a customer has a Sev1 outage and requires engineering assistance

**What We Need To See**

* BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* At least 5+ years system software development and troubleshooting experience, ideally with some customer facing
* Strong computer science fundamentals and programming/scripting skills (Python required; Bash; Go/C++ a plus) to automate investigations and build diagnostics/repro tools
* Strong troubleshooting fundamentals (networking, concurrency, OS concepts) and a structured approach to isolating issues across application, platform, and infrastructure layers
* Deep understanding of at least two of the following: data centers/servers, distributed systems, virtualization, deep learning frameworks, containers (Docker/Kubernetes), hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD for reliable deployments
* Familiarity with GPU-accelerated AI/ML stacks and production model deployment/serving (e.g., NGC containers, CUDA/tooling concepts, inference serving such as Triton or similar)
* Deep Linux knowledge and comfort troubleshooting in production Linux environments; working knowledge of Windows is a plus
* Professional-level communication skills, interpersonal skills with a passion to solve problems

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Hands-on experience deploying and operating NVIDIA AI Enterprise components in production across on-prem or CSP environments
* Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants/tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) to accelerate debugging, automation, and test creation
* Experience operating Kubernetes-based platforms in production (cluster operations, upgrades, control-plane/data-plane failure modes)
* Strong performance debugging skills for GPU and cloud workloads (profiling, latency/throughput tuning) and familiarity with observability/tracing tools

title: Automation Engineer I
description:
**Job Purpose**
This role involves building, testing, and deploying end-to-end intelligent automation solutions to streamline business workflows, minimize manual intervention, and improve overall operational efficiency.
  
  
In this role, you will work closely with senior engineers, business analysts, and functional stakeholders. You will leverage Automation Anywhere (A360), custom Python scripting, modern integration platforms like Unify Apps, and emerging Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to turn complex, repetitive manual processes into scalable, intelligent digital workflows. This position is ideal for an early-career engineer or recent graduate who combines foundational programming logic with strong communication and collaborative problem-solving skills.
  
  
Key Result Responsibilities
  
  
Solution Development & Implementation
  
  
Build, configure, and maintain Robotic Process Automation (RPA) bots using Automation Anywhere (Control Room, Bot Creator, Bot Insight).
  
  
Develop custom Python scripts to handle complex data manipulation, file processing, API integrations, and tasks outside native bot actions.
  
  
Leverage Unify Apps or similar low-code/integration platforms to create seamless triggers, user interfaces, and application-to-application workflows.
  
  
Assist in incorporating AI/GenAI components (e.g., document extraction via IDP/IQ Bot, basic LLM API calls, prompt engineering, pattern recognition) to transform deterministic bots into cognitive automations.
  
  
Testing, Deployment & MonitoringConduct comprehensive unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), and participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) defect resolution.
  
  
Support deployment into staging and production environments following standard CI/CD and release management processes.
  
  
Monitor bot performance, review execution logs, troubleshoot runtime exceptions, and implement fixes to minimize downtime.
  
  
Collaboration & Stakeholder Communication
  
  
Partner with cross-functional teams and business analysts to analyze "as-is" manual workflows and help translate them into technical "to-be" architectures.
  
  
Create clear technical documentation, including Process Design Documents (PDD), Solution Design Documents (SDD), and operational runbooks.
  
  
Provide clear, concise progress updates during daily standups and sprint planning ceremonies.
  
  
**Technical Qualifications**
Qualifications (Academic, training, languages)
  
  
Experience: 0 to 4 years of hands-on experience in software development, test automation, or robotic process automation (relevant internships and capstone projects included).
  
  
**Preferred Education & Certifications**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
  
  
Work Experience
  
  
RPA Platforms: Working knowledge or hands-on project exposure to Automation Anywhere (A2019 / A360 architecture, credential management, work queues).
  
  
Programming: Proficient in Python (core libraries, data handling with pandas/json, interacting with REST APIs using requests).
  
  
Platform Integration: Exposure to Unify Apps or comparable workflow orchestration platforms.
  
  
AI Fundamentals: Foundational understanding of AI/ML principles, Intelligent Document Processing (IDP), and basic familiarity with API-driven AI services (e.g., OpenAI API, cloud vision/NLP APIs).
  
  
Database & Web Basics: Foundational knowledge of SQL, basic web technologies (HTML, JSON, XML), and Git version control.
  
  
Soft Skills & Core Attributes
  
  
Team-First Mindset: High receptivity to feedback, active participation in peer code reviews, and eagerness to learn from senior engineers.
  
  
Communication Skills: Demonstrated ability to explain technical details clearly to non-technical teammates, both in written documentation and verbal discussions.
  
  
Analytical Problem-Solving: Ability to deconstruct a broken workflow logically, isolate root causes, and iterate toward a stable fix.

title: QA Automation Engineer (Remote, Full-Time) [HR217]
description:
**About Smart Working**

  
  

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.

  
  

Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

  

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

  
  

**About the Role**

  

As a QA Automation Engineer, you will take end-to-end ownership of quality across a large, roughly 10-year, multi-repo digital health platform. You will build the automated test framework hands-on, define expected behaviour, and help improve reliability from an existing baseline where test coverage and pass rates need strengthening.

  

You will work with an engineering team of 4, collaborating to understand how the system should work from client, end-user and internal operations perspectives. The role is predominantly hands-on and independent, with shared responsibility for product quality.

  

The first phase will involve speaking with stakeholders, clarifying requirements, documenting expected behaviour, and building out automation that enables faster, safer releases.

**Responsibilities**
  

  
* Own the quality process end to end and build the automated test framework hands-on.
  
* Understand how a large, roughly 10-year, multi-repo system works and how it should work from client, end-user and internal operations perspectives.
  
* Ask the right questions and document expected behaviour where inherited documentation is partly out of date.
  
* Author English-readable scenarios in Cucumber and Gherkin.
  
* Build automation in JavaScript and TypeScript.
  
* Drive the UI through a page object model.
  
* Add data-test-ids to React code where missing.
  
* Validate correct database state using SQL.
  
* Maintain the automated tests as new features arrive.
  
* Feed into requirements upfront as new features are planned.
  
* Flag compliance, regulatory and security implications.
  
* Run exploratory testing to identify where the product behaves incorrectly.
  
* Improve reliability and enable faster, safer releases through automation.
  
* Reproduce multi-step defects precisely and identify edge cases.
  
* Build a repeatable, documented QA process from an unreliable baseline.
  
* Work out how the system should behave across multiple user perspectives and how it might break.
  

  
**Requirements**
  

  
* 4+ years of experience in QA or test automation, hands-on with TypeScript or JavaScript.
  
* 4+ years of hands-on test automation coding in TypeScript or JavaScript.
  
* 2+ years of BDD test authoring with Cucumber and Gherkin.
  
* 3+ years of web UI test automation using a page object model, preferably with Playwright.
  
* 2+ years of end-to-end QA ownership, including defining, documenting, building and maintaining tests.
  
* 3+ years of requirements analysis and stakeholder communication.
  
* 2+ years of SQL querying to validate database state, using MySQL or PostgreSQL.
  
* 3+ years of exploratory testing and precise multi-step defect reproduction.
  
* Ability to drive automation and own the build with limited direction.
  
* Strong detail orientation, including the ability to spot edge cases and gaps in specifications.
  
* Hands-on JavaScript or TypeScript automation coding is non-negotiable; willingness to learn is not sufficient.
  

  
**Nice to Have**
  

  
* Mobile app testing and automation experience, especially with Flutter apps.
  
* Experience with Appium or Flutter integration\_test.
  
* Experience reading and working with React front-end code.
  
* Experience with Angular, Vue or another modern JavaScript framework.
  
* Security and regulatory awareness, including ISO 27001, GDPR or NHS DTAC.
  
* Experience in another regulated or audited environment.
  
* ISO 13485 medical-device regulated-environment testing.
  
* Experience in an adjacent regulated domain such as medtech, fintech or NHS/DTAC.
  
* Healthtech or digital health domain experience.
  
* Comfort using AI in the engineering workflow.
  

  
**Benefits**
  

  
* Fixed Shifts: 12:00 PM - 9:30 PM IST (Summer) | 1:00 PM - 10:30 PM IST (Winter)
  
* No Weekend Work: Real work-life balance, not just words
  
* Day 1 Benefits: Laptop and full medical insurance provided
  
* Support That Matters:Mentorship, community, and forums where ideas are shared
  
* True Belonging: A long-term career where your contributions are valued
