description:
**Job Summary**
This applied technology position creates software that is sold as an integral part of Cummins’ products. People in these positions have involvement in identification and understanding of stakeholder requirements and developing specifications, and responsibility for design, implementation, testing and/or release of software that controls the operation of Cummins’ products in a variety of customer applications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Investigates product software problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution, and documents results. Applies and improves the improvement of product software development processes and tools. Processes include coding, compiling and test. Tools include code editors, integration tools, static analysis tools, compilers and hardware in the loop test tools. Details specific to this role may be found at the end of this document. Obtains input and negotiates with product and software development teams and delivers verified software features, components, builds to product teams. Uses systems knowledge and expertise to make decisions in the areas of software requirements, architecture, design, and test that impact the quality and performance of software builds, product lines (platforms) and management of cross-BU integration and coordination. Responsible for review of less-experienced developers/testers’ work to ensure robust, reusable, and efficient designs. Responsibile for interacting and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across function(s) within a global business unit or managing improvement across business units. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.
  
  
**Competencies**
Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.
  
  
Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.
  
  
Product Platform Planning and Architecting - Creates and develops a holistic product platform including key architectural feature and function variants needed to align with market level product plans of future target markets; generates alternative architectures traceable to the requirements and performs trade-off analysis in collaboration with life-cycle stakeholders to ensure a balanced and optimum platform; communicates and maintains traceable information and plans executed by product development teams.
  
  
Product Software Design and Construction - Constructs product software using industry best practices and robust software engineering principles; verifies software updates to ensure quality products.
  
  
Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.
  
  
System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
  
  
Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.
  
  
Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.
  
  
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
  
  
Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
  
  
Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
  
  
Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.
  
  
Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.
  
  
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  
  
**Experience**
Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Functional Safety (FuSa) Software Developer is responsible for developing, verifying, and maintaining safety-critical software in compliance with ISO 26262 for automotive electronic systems. The role ensures that software components meet defined ASIL requirements and supports the full safety lifecycle from concept to production.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities – Functional Safety Engineering**

* Implement software safety requirements derived from system and hardware safety requirements.
* Ensure compliance with ISO 26262 Part 6.
* Develop safety-related embedded software in C/C++.
* Implement safety mechanisms such as watchdogs, redundancy, diagnostics, and safe-state handling.
* Work with MCU-based platforms and RTOS environments.
* Develop unit and integration tests.
* Execute requirement-based testing.
* Support ASIL-compliant verification and coverage analysis.
* Participate in audits and safety reviews.
* Prepare ISO 26262 compliant work products.
* Maintain traceability between requirements, design, code, and tests.
* Support OEM and supplier safety documentation.
* Participate in requirements discussions.
* Connect with external stake holders to clarify requirements assist in system level testing.

**Technical Skills**

* Embedded C/C++ ISO 26262 (Part 6)
* AUTOSAR knowledge (preferred)
* RTOS concepts
* MISRA-C compliance

**Tools & Standards**

* Git, windchill, Eclipse, doxygen
* Unit test tools like vector cast
* Static analysis tools (Polyspace, QAC)
* Debugging tools (JTAG, Lauterbach)
* Analytical and problem-solving mindset
* Strong documentation skills
* Effective communication
* Cross-functional collaboration

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics or Embedded Systems
* 6-8 years of automotive embedded software experience
* Prior functional safety project exposure preferred

**Nice to Have**

description:
**Scope**

* The individual will be responsible for designing, planning, and executing performance, load, stress, endurance, and scalability testing for enterprise applications.
* Also, the individual will be responsible for analysing application behaviour and identify performance bottlenecks across application, database, infrastructure, and network layers.

**Technical Environment**

* Performance Testing Tools: Jmeter
* API/Application: REST APIs, JSON/XML, HTTP/HTTPS, Web applications, Microservices, Postman
* Scripting & Development: JavaScript, Groovy, Python, Shell scripting
* Databases: Oracle, MariaDb; SQL query analysis and database performance analysis
* Database Performance: Oracle AWR/ASH, execution plans, SQL tuning, database CPU/memory/I/O analysis
* Application & JVM Monitoring: JVM, Garbage Collection (GC), Heap/Thread Dumps, JProfiler, Eclipse MAT or equivalent tools
* Infrastructure & Monitoring: Linux, Kubernetes, Docker, OCI/Azure, CPU/Memory/Disk/Network monitoring, Grafana, OEM
* DevOps/Agile: Git, Jenkins
* Cloud: OCI/Azure integrations
* Others: RDP/SSH, Linux command-line utilities, log analysis, performance profiling, capacity planning, and production performance monitoring.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design and execute performance, load, stress, endurance, and scalability tests for enterprise applications.
* Develop and maintain JMeter/API performance test scripts, workload models, test data, and execution scenarios.
* Analyse application performance across application, database, JVM, infrastructure, and network layers.
* Monitor system behaviour during load tests and identify CPU, memory, database, JVM, I/O, and response-time bottlenecks.
* Perform root-cause analysis of performance issues using application logs, monitoring tools, AWR/ASH reports, thread dumps, heap dumps, and GC logs.

* Analyse test results and prepare performance reports, dashboards, and recommendations for stakeholders.

* Participate in release planning and provide performance assessment and recommendations for production deployment.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.
* 1-3 years of experience in Performance Testing / Performance Engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with JMeter and performance test scripting.
* Good understanding of load, stress, endurance, scalability, and volume testing.
* Strong experience in API performance testing using REST/HTTP, JSON/XML, and Postman.
* Good understanding of Java/JVM, including heap, threads, GC, and JVM tuning.
* Experience with JProfiler, Eclipse MAT, thread/heap dumps, and GC logs.
* Experience with Linux/Unix, shell scripting, and application/log analysis.
* Good knowledge of SQL and database performance, preferably Oracle, including AWR/ASH and execution plan analysis on OEM.
* Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, InfluxDB, or equivalent monitoring tools.
* Understanding of Kubernetes/containerized environments and exposure to OCI/Azure is preferred.
* Strong performance troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple performance testing activities within timelines.

If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values

title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering
description:
**Our Company:**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do:**
We are seeking a Senior Manager to lead our Database Performance Testing and Characterization organization. This leader will manage a high-impact team responsible for performance benchmarking, regressions, scalability, and workload characterization across releases, platforms, and customer scenarios.
  
  
You will also be accountable for transforming how performance testing is executed, analyzed, and validated—modernizing the practice through automation, AI/Agent-assisted analysis, intelligent validation, and resilient test pipelines. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of leading teams through transformation initiatives that measurably improve productivity, quality, cycle time, and operational resiliency.
  
  
**Your Opportunity:**

* Lead and grow a team of performance engineers responsible for end-to-end performance testing of a database product (benchmarks, workloads, regressions, scalability, concurrency, and reliability under load).
* Own the team’s delivery commitments for performance characterization requests across internal stakeholders (engineering, product, release, support) and external/customer-driven scenarios.
* Drive a transformation roadmap for performance testing that improves:
* Execution automation (repeatable runs through orchestration pipelines that are self-healing, observable and secure)
* Result analysis using AI and Agents(regression detection, noise modeling, confidence scoring, explainability)
* Root Cause Analysis Automation using AI/ML techniques (root-cause hypothesis generation, correlation analysis, report synthesis for performance issues)
* Modernize Test Framework to expand capabilities and assist in shift-left abilities
* Partner with engineering, architecture, and release teams to translate product changes into performance risk assessments and targeted test plans.
* Influence design decisions by providing early performance insights and recommendations.
* Communicate clearly to senior leadership: performance readiness, risks, mitigation plans, and trends using metrics and executive-ready summaries.
* Implement governance: baselines, test data versioning, environment parity, noise controls, and auditability of results.

**Who you will work with:**
This opportunity is within the Internal Engineering Organization. Team comprises of multiple global scrum teams working towards a common goal to test and release Teradata Vantage Platform and AI Products on various on-prem and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GC) with quality and performance guidelines.
  
  
Fast-paced, flexible, fun. That describes our work environment. . . a place to brainstorm with the best data minds, engage customers and surprise yourself with what’s possible, every day.
  
  
**What makes you a qualified candidate:**

* 10+ years in performance engineering, test engineering, systems engineering, or a related discipline; 4+ years leading teams and delivering transformation roadmaps.
* Demonstrated experience in database performance testing or closely related systems (distributed systems, storage engines, query optimizers, large-scale compute platforms).
* Strong understanding of performance metrics and analysis: CPU, I/O, memory, concurrency, latency/throughput, query plans, system contention, and benchmarking methodologies.
* Proven track record modernizing engineering practices through automation and operational rigor (CI/CD, test orchestration, observability, reliability engineering).
* Proven experience applying AI/ML and/or LLM-based tooling to improve engineering productivity (analysis automation, anomaly detection, summarization, intelligent triage).
* Strong cross-functional leadership skills: ability to align stakeholders, negotiate priorities, and deliver outcomes in complex environments.
* Excellent communication skills and experience presenting to senior leadership.

**What You’ll Bring**
  
  

+ Hands-on experience with one or more:

- Database internals (optimizer behavior, execution engine, indexing, statistics)
- Performance tooling (profilers, tracers, query plan analyzers, APM)
- Python/SQL-based analytics and visualization; statistical methods for noise and confidence intervals
- Cloud performance testing across AWS/Azure/GCP

+ Experience building internal platforms for: test scheduling/orchestration, results repositories, dashboards, automated regression detection using AI.
+ Familiarity with modern AI/agent patterns for engineering workflows (RAG for runbooks, agentic root-cause assistants, evaluation harnesses).
+ Experience with security and compliance expectations for AI-enabled systems (data handling, access controls, audit trails).
+ Background working in organizations undergoing AI proficiency/AI adoption transformation.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

**Position Overview**
**Job Title: Software Development Engineer in Test**
**Corporate Title: Vice President**
**Location: Pune, India**
**Role Description**
This role is responsible for owning product quality and defining and implementing AI-first engineering and automated validation solutions for the Account Information Platform. The candidate should demonstrate strong software engineering expertise, excellent problem-solving skills, and an agents-first mindset, with the ability to apply agentic AI approaches to testing while leading quality engineering through hands-on development. The candidate is expected to:
  
  

* Bring an AI-first and agent-first approach to quality engineering by identifying, designing, and implementing agentic AI use cases across test design, automation, execution, analysis, and reporting.
* Own quality for the Account Information Platform, including test strategy, risk assessment, regression execution, release-readiness reporting, and quality sign-off for production releases.
* Contribute as a hands-on senior engineer involved in analysis, design, and code reviews, coding, automation framework development, and release activities.
* Work closely with business stakeholders, the Tribe Lead, Product Owner, architects, developers, SRE, and platform teams to successfully deliver business outcomes.
* Acquire strong functional knowledge of account-information capabilities, customer journeys, data flows, and services delivered through the Account Information Platform.
* Demonstrate ownership, inspire others, apply innovative thinking and a growth mindset, and collaborate across teams for success.

**What We’ll Offer You**
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,
  
  

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead an AI-first, agents-first approach to testing by identifying and implementing agentic AI patterns for requirements analysis, test design, code generation, test-data preparation, execution orchestration, defect triage, root-cause analysis, and quality reporting.
* Define the automation strategy, framework design, engineering standards, and scalable patterns for validating account-information journeys across web interfaces, APIs, services, data flows, and integrations.
* Design and develop critical automation components, reusable libraries, utilities, AI-enabled testing tools, and test agents using Java, Selenium, Playwright, and scripting languages; establish high standards through robust code and design reviews.
* Partner with developers and architects to embed testability, observability, security, reliability, and automated quality gates throughout design, development, CI/CD, release, and production validation.
* Build and maintain reliable risk-based regression capabilities, drive effective execution and result analysis, and use engineering metrics and root-cause analysis to reduce escaped defects, flaky tests, and repetitive manual effort.
* Coach engineers in AI-enabled testing, modern development and test practices, foster continuous learning, and build a culture where quality is an engineering responsibility shared across the product team.
* Translate quality risks, AI-enabled testing opportunities, regression outcomes, and release-readiness evidence into clear business terms for product, technology, and executive stakeholders.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Proven ability to define and implement agentic AI approaches for software testing, including the use of autonomous or semi-autonomous agents for test design, automation development, execution orchestration, defect triage, analysis, and reporting.
* Strong agents-first mindset, with the ability to identify where AI agents can improve coverage, engineering productivity, decision-making, and delivery confidence while retaining appropriate human oversight and control.
* Practical experience with generative AI, coding assistants, prompt engineering, agent workflows, tool integration, and evaluation of AI-generated code and test artefacts for correctness, security, maintainability, and responsible use.
* Minimum 14 years of IT industry experience, with substantial hands-on experience in software development, test engineering, product-quality ownership, and delivery of complex business-critical systems.
* Expert-level programming skills in Java, with the ability to develop clean, maintainable, reusable, and production-quality automation code and engineering frameworks.
* Strong hands-on experience with Selenium and Playwright for browser and end-to-end automation, including framework design, parallel execution, cross-browser validation, and test reliability.
* Strong scripting capability using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Shell scripting for automation, AI-agent tooling, data preparation, and engineering productivity.
* Deep experience in API and service-level automation using tools and libraries such as REST Assured, with a sound understanding of REST, JSON, XML, authentication, and integration testing.
* Demonstrated experience owning test strategy, risk-based regression scope and execution, defect governance, release-readiness assessment, and quality sign-off for production releases.
* Strong knowledge of software design principles, object-oriented programming, debugging, code reviews, and engineering practices that support scalable and maintainable solutions.
* Experience integrating automated validation and AI-enabled testing capabilities into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions, with good knowledge of Git and build tools such as Maven or Gradle.
* Experience with test environments, test data management, databases and SQL, service virtualisation or mocking, observability tools, and evidence-based quality reporting.
* Good understanding of performance, security, accessibility, reliability, contract, and risk-based testing, with the ability to incorporate relevant checks into engineering workflows.
* Proven technical leadership, stakeholder management, mentoring, and communication skills, combined with the ability to remain a hands-on individual contributor.

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**
**How We’ll Support You**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career.
* Coaching and support from experts in your team.
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.

**About Us And Our Teams**
Please visit our company website for further information:
  
  
**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**
We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.
  
  
Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.
  
  
We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**The Opportunity**
ACA believes that we can deliver the world’s best GRC software to our blue-chip financial services client base of over 3500 firms. We are seeking top talent to join us in our journey to build and deliver “The Salesforce of Compliance”. Compliance Officers in finance have been stuck in the past, with inefficient, manual effort driving their compliance programs. ACA’s ComplianceAlpha is deployed at 800+ clients, with more added daily, to help modernize that. We are investing significantly to drive technology adoption among our clients.
  
  
The SDET role is responsible for the development and delivery of an automation-first test suite for our ComplianceAlpha products. Each SDET will be part of a geo-located agile product team, and will provide guidance to the team during planning and refinement as well as execute on the plan during the sprint.
  
  
We are looking for an imaginative self-starter with a passion for great software and a curiosity for developing test automation solutions that drive exceptional quality and productivity. Only motivated problem solvers willing to take the initiative and demonstrate consistent follow-through need apply. Qualified candidates will have hands-on experience building automated tests and a drive to keep growing their skills.
  
  
**What To Expect Day To Day**
As a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) on the Connectors team, you’ll help ensure the reliability of data pipelines that ingest and process large volumes of data from platforms such as Microsoft Teams, Slack, Zoom, Bloomberg, and other enterprise systems.
  
  
On a typical day, you will:
  
  
  

* Work alongside a highly collaborative and talented engineering team.
* Design, develop, and execute automated functional tests to ensure the reliability and quality of our data pipelines.
* Collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into effective test coverage.
* Investigate failures, identify root causes, and help improve the overall quality of our platform.
* Explore and adopt new testing techniques, tools, and automation strategies.
* Expand your Python expertise while working with modern data engineering technologies.
* Participate in manual validation and release testing during production release cycles when needed.

**Required Skills**
**Skills and attributes for success**

* Curious, lifelong learner who is excited to develop new skills and explore new technologies.
* Passionate about software quality, automation, and continuous improvement.
* At least 2 years of experience developing software in Python.
* Experience developing automated test pipelines for Python-based ETL processes.
* Experience consuming REST APIs using Python.
* Working knowledge of asynchronous Python (asyncio) and strategies for testing asynchronous code.
* Experience translating business requirements into automated functional tests.

**Nice to have**

* Experience developing automated tests for Apache Airflow pipelines.
* Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
* Experience testing data-intensive or distributed systems.
* Familiarity with AWS services commonly used in data pipelines.

**What We Look For**
We are interested in innovative technology professionals with strong vision and a desire to stay on top of trends in the industry. If you have a genuine passion for new technologies and transforming an entire industry, this role may be for you. A BE or B-Tech in computer Science, or equivalent is a great preference.
  
  
**What Working At ACA Offers**
We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options as well as a flexible work environment. You’ll also be granted time off for designated ACA Paid Holidays, Summer Fridays, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
  
  
**Plus, we offer:**

* Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**Why join our team?**
We are the leading governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) advisor in financial services. When you join ACA, you'll become part of a team whose unique combination of talent includes the industry's largest team of former regulators, compliance professionals, legal professionals, and GIPS® standards verifiers in the industry, along with practitioners in cybersecurity, ESG, and regulatory technology.
  
  
Our team enjoys an entrepreneurial work environment by offering innovative and tailored solutions for our clients. We encourage creative thinking and making the most of your experience at ACA by offering multiple career paths. We foster a culture of growth by focusing on continuous learning through inquiry and curiosity, and transparency. If you’re ready to be part of an award-winning, global team of thoughtful, talented, and committed professionals, you’ve come to the right place.
  
  
**More About ACA**
ACA was founded in 2002 by four former SEC regulators and one former state regulator. The founders saw a need for investment advisers to receive expert guidance on existing and new regulations.
  
  
Over the years, ACA has grown both organically and by acquisition to expand our GRC business and technology solutions. Our services now include GIPS standards verification, cybersecurity and technology risk, regulatory technology, ESG advisory, AML and financial crimes, financial and regulatory reporting, and Mirabella for establishing EU operations.
  
  
**What We Commit To**
ACA is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. We conduct our business without regard to actual or perceived age, race, color, religion, disability, caregiver, marital or partnership status, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), ancestry, national origin and citizenship, sex, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, sexual and reproductive health decisions, military or veteran status, creed, genetic predisposition, carrier status or any other category protected by federal, state and local law.
  
  
ACA is firmly committed to a policy of nondiscrimination, which applies to recruiting, hiring, placement, promotions, training, discipline, terminations, layoffs, recall, transfers, leaves of absence, compensation and all other terms and conditions of employment.
  
  
Here at ACA, we have created a variety of programs to promote ACA’s culture of inclusivity and work hard to ensure that all our employees have an equal opportunity to contribute to ACA and feel that ACA is exactly where they belong.

title: Technical Leader – Embedded Software Development
description:
**Job Description**
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Design and implement embedded real-time software solutions that meet functional safety and cybersecurity requirements.
* Contribute to system architecture, system requirements definition, and software design activities.
* Allocate system requirements to software components and technical subsystems.
* Develop high-quality embedded software using C, C++, and scripting languages.
* Participate in agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily collaboration, and retrospectives.
* Perform object-oriented design, coding, debugging, and optimization of embedded applications.
* Conduct peer code reviews and ensure compliance with coding standards and secure development practices.
* Manage source code, branching, and releases using version control systems such as Git.
* Develop and execute unit, integration, and system-level testing activities.
* Investigate and resolve software defects and hardware-software integration issues.
* Prototype software solutions on custom hardware and support low-level board bring-up activities.
* Use debugging and diagnostic tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG, and debuggers to identify and resolve technical issues.
* Build and maintain Embedded Linux environments, including device drivers, device trees, boot loaders, and Yocto-based distributions.
* Implement data protection and cybersecurity features across products and development processes.
* Support compliance with cybersecurity standards, regulations, and product certification requirements, including EU Cyber Resilience Act (EU-CRA) considerations.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives involving performance optimization, code refactoring, automation, and software quality enhancement.
* Mentor team members and provide technical guidance to support team growth and project success.
* Collaborate effectively with colleagues, stakeholders, and partners across multiple geographic locations.

**Who You Are:**
You anticipate future possibilities and translate them into innovative solutions. You consistently deliver results, even under challenging circumstances. You build partnerships and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. You develop and deliver clear, effective communication that supports understanding, engagement, and successful outcomes across diverse teams.
  
  
**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Strong experience developing embedded software on Linux-based platforms.
* Advanced programming skills in C, C++, and shell scripting.
* Experience with device driver development, Yocto build systems, and device tree configuration.
* Knowledge of boot loaders, preferably U-Boot, and familiarity with Linux kernel concepts.
* Experience working with ARM, PowerPC, or comparable embedded processor architectures.
* Understanding of embedded hardware components such as flash memory, ADCs, and RTC devices.
* Experience using industrial communication protocols including I2C, SPI, CAN, RS-232, RS-485, or Modbus.
* Knowledge of data management using SQLite, JSON, or similar technologies.
* Ability to develop, execute, and maintain unit and integration testing solutions.
* Experience using debugging tools such as GDB, JTAG, J-Link, and related technologies.
* Knowledge of secure coding practices and software vulnerability management.
* Understanding of open-source software licensing considerations.
* Experience working within agile software development methodologies.
* Familiarity with virtualized development environments.
* Experience using Azure DevOps or similar platforms for software lifecycle management and CI/CD implementation.
* Experience implementing encryption and data security mechanisms for embedded products.
* Ability to identify, analyze, and address software security vulnerabilities using industry-standard tools and practices.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Ability to adapt, learn quickly, and work effectively in evolving environments.
* Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Instrumentation, Telecommunications, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**

* Experience developing products used for temperature, pressure, electricity, gas, or industrial measurement applications.
* Knowledge of UML or comparable modeling techniques for software architecture and design.
* Experience working with RTOS environments.
* Experience developing user interfaces using the Qt framework.
* Familiarity with distributed version control systems and collaborative development practices.
* Experience with static code analysis and coding standards compliance tools.
* Knowledge of software build automation frameworks and cross-platform development practices.
* Experience developing multi-threaded applications on single-core or multi-core processors.
* Exposure to cybersecurity standards and frameworks such as IEC 62443 and EU-CRA.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools to enhance coding, testing, or productivity workflows.
* Familiarity with threat modeling techniques and security-focused development methodologies.
* Experience collaborating with geographically distributed engineering teams.

**Our Culture and Commitment To You:**
At Emerson, we foster a workplace where innovation, collaboration, and respect drive everything we do. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued and empowered to contribute their unique perspectives. We encourage continuous learning, professional growth, and the exploration of new ideas. Our teams work together across regions, disciplines, and backgrounds to solve meaningful challenges and deliver technologies that make a positive impact on customers and communities around the world.

**Job Summary**
Black & Veatch is expanding its Power SCADA team to support a strategic grid modernization initiative focused on IEC 61850‑based substation automation and virtual substation technologies. As a founding member of the Virtual Protection, Automation, and Control (vPAC) Alliance, Black & Veatch is collaborating with industry leaders to advance open, secure, and vendor‑agnostic digital substation solutions that replace traditional, hardware‑intensive architectures with virtualized, software‑defined platforms. Following successful pilot efforts, BV is now transitioning virtual substations into production environments. This role is being created to bring in experienced SCADA professionals who can help design, implement, standardize, and support production‑ready Power SCADA solutions that enable resilient, flexible, and future‑ready grid infrastructure
  
  
In this role, you may have the opportunity to:
  
  

* Lead the transition of IEC 61850‑based digital and virtual substations from pilot to production, shaping real-world grid modernization outcomes.
* Design and standardize secure, vendor‑agnostic substation automation architectures that improve resilience, flexibility, and scalability.
* Serve as a technical leader and subject‑matter expert, influencing system architecture, best practices, and emerging standards.
* Collaborate with utilities, technology partners, and industry groups (including vPAC Alliance) to help define the future of protection, automation, and control

**Key Responsibilities**
IEC 61850 Engineering & Modeling
  
  

* Develop SCL engineering artifacts including ICD, CID, and SCD files, datasets, logical node mappings, reporting and control blocks, and GOOSE publications and subscriptions.
* Configure and validate MMS, GOOSE, and SV messaging for protection, automation, monitoring, and SCADA applications.

Substation Networking & Time Synchronization
  
  

* Design and document station-bus and process-bus network architectures using PRP/HSR, VLANs, QoS, multicast management, and traffic segmentation practices.
* Design deterministic real-time networking paths for time-sensitive protection and automation applications, incorporating latency budgeting, PTP timing performance, and behaviors defined for substation-class devices meeting IEC 61850-3 and IEEE 1613 environmental and EMC requirements.
* Diagnose and optimize real-time network behavior through traffic-capture analysis, timing-accuracy evaluation, and system-level tuning techniques for time-critical digital-substation workloads.
* Develop PTP-based time-synchronization architectures including grandmaster, boundary, and transparent clock configurations and incorporate timing considerations into the system design.

Protection, Automation & SCADA Integration
  
  

* Integrate multi-vendor IEDs with protection settings and logic, coordinating measurements, controls, alarms, and event data with SCADA and HMI systems.
* Apply IEC 61850 data-modeling concepts to confirm interoperability across mixed fleets of protection and control devices.

Cybersecurity & System Hardening
  
  

* Incorporate cybersecurity principles into system architecture, including authentication, role-based access control, network segmentation, secure communications, and device hardening.
* Apply cyber-informed engineering principles by identifying high-consequence functions and integrating protective measures directly into system architecture, embedding security decisions from the earliest stages of engineering rather than treating them as add-on controls.

Virtualization of Substation Functions
  
  

* Develop and configure virtualized protection, HMI, gateway/RTU, and related substation applications on platforms including VMware ESXi with vCenter, vSAN, and NSX; Red Hat KVM or OpenShift Virtualization; and SEAPATH’s real-time, high-availability hypervisor platform designed to run virtualized protection, automation, and control workloads with deterministic performance and PTP-synchronized operation on industrial servers meeting IEC 61850-3 and IEEE 1613 criteria.

Industry Engagement & Technical Leadership
  
  

* Contribute to, or develop toward contributing to, IEEE and IEC standards and collaborative initiatives related to IEC 61850, digital substations, time synchronization, and cybersecurity.
* Support participation in technical bodies and industry groups such as IEC, IEEE, CIGRE, ISA99, and vPAC Alliance workstreams.
* Support the advancement and practical application of virtualized protection, automation, and control concepts in alignment with the architectural direction established by the vPAC Alliance.

Project Delivery & Collaboration
  
  

* Produce engineering documentation including network specifications, SCL models, timing plans, interface definitions, and system diagrams used across design, laboratory validation, and field implementation.
* Collaborate with project managers, technical leads, clients, and vendors to align designs with project goals, operational requirements, and industry best practices.

**Management Responsibilities**
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks for operational technology environments, including secure communications and system-hardening practices.
* Interest or participation in IEEE and IEC standards development related to IEC 61850, time synchronization, digital substations, and cybersecurity.
* Experience deploying or supporting virtualized protection, automation, and control applications on VMware ESXi/vCenter/vSAN/NSX, Red Hat KVM or OpenShift Virtualization, and SEAPATH’s real-time, high-availability hypervisor platform for vPAC workloads.
* Experience deploying virtualized substation workloads on industrial servers certified to IEC 618503 and IEEE 1613 environmental and EMC requirements.
* Familiarity with vPAC architectural principles and emerging practices for hosting protection, automation, and control systems on virtualized platforms.
* Interest in or experience with virtualized protection, automation, and control concepts.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering from either a recognized accredited program in their home country or the country in which the professional is practicing or equivalent experience in Engineering work.
* Minimum of 11 years related work experience.
* All applicants must be able to complete pre-employment onboarding requirements (if selected) which may include any/all of the following: criminal/civil background check, drug screen, and motor vehicle records search, in compliance with any applicable laws and regulations.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
QA Senior Engineer, Functional & Automation Lead
  
  
Deloitte Consulting LLP | IDT
  
  
**About The Role**
The QA Senior Engineer, Functional & Automation Lead owns test strategy, planning, and execution across Deloitte's IDT product portfolio, leading manual testing efforts while driving the shift toward greater automation and GenAI-enabled QA practices, and mentoring the QA engineers around them.
  
  
Innovations Delivery Transformation (IDT) is the organization within Deloitte Consulting Services that builds a culture of continuous innovation, driving profitable revenue through the identification and incubation of breakthrough, IP-asset-based businesses and markets. As Deloitte's leading-edge product development center, IDT builds cloud-based software and advanced analytics products — spanning wearables, machine learning, social/mobile, and other emerging technologies — bringing together UX/UI designers, architects, engineers, infrastructure and operations staff, testers, and developers, all following rigorous software quality assurance methods and standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Test Strategy & Planning
  
  

* Own the preparation and documentation of test artifacts, including Test Plans, Test Strategy, Test Cases, and sign-off reports
* Design and drive comprehensive testing strategies for new features, enhancements, and bug fixes across full software release cycles

Test Execution
  
  

* Lead and execute all core manual testing phases: functional testing, regression, end-to-end, exploratory, API, smoke, sanity, risk-based, and ad hoc test cycles

* Mentor and guide junior team members, fostering growth in QA best practices and innovation
* Proactively identify manual processes suitable for automation; lead, promote, and implement strategies to increase test automation coverage over time
* Advocate for and accelerate GenAI adoption in QA — evaluate, introduce, and enable the use of AI-powered tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot or equivalents) for test script automation, exploratory testing support, or intelligent defect triage
* Collaborate to continuously evolve automation and AI/ML practices within the QA function, ensuring the team stays ahead of the curve

Quality Enablement & Risk Management
  
  

* Contribute to non-functional QA initiatives (performance, security, accessibility) and integrate AI/automation approaches where appropriate
* Proactively identify , communicate, and mitigate QA risks and quality gaps

Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Interact and coordinate with cross-functional teams to clarify acceptance criteria, engage in defect triages, and prioritize business-critical issues
* Present test results, technology advancements, risks, and business impact clearly to product management and engineering leaders

Reporting Relationships
  
  
Reports to a QA Manager or Engineering Manager within IDT. Leads and mentors QA engineers, and collaborates with developers, BAs, product management, and engineering leaders across Agile teams.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Information Technology, or a related field
* 6-9 years of professional experience in software testing/QA, with deep expertise in manual testing methodology and processes
* Hands-on experience using Jira, Azure DevOps (ADO), or similar test management and defect tracking tools
* Strong track record in creating, executing, and maintaining test artifacts
* Demonstrated understanding of SDLC, Agile methods, and Agile operational ceremonies
* Experience in multiple testing types: functional, regression, exploratory, API, smoke, sanity, risk-based, and end-to-end testing
* Proactive in identifying and leading test automation opportunities, working closely with automation engineers or upskilling in frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Java, Python, or similar
* Awareness of GenAI trends in QA, with experience utilizing and/or advocating AI-powered tools such as GitHub Copilot, OpenAI, or equivalents to improve efficiency, accuracy, and test coverage
* Hands-on experience with API testing tools (such as Postman, Swagger, or REST-assured)
* Excellent analytical, leadership, and communication skills with a passion for innovation and mentoring

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience building or maintaining automation frameworks
* Direct exposure to performance, security, or accessibility testing tools
* Experience championing new tooling or methods (automation or AI) within project teams
* Experience leveraging AI/ML-based tools for test case generation, automation, or code review

Core Competencies
  
  

* Test strategy and documentation discipline
* Automation-forward mindset and drive to modernize QA practices
* GenAI and AI-tool advocacy within quality engineering
* Clear communication of test results, risk, and business impact
* Mentorship and QA team leadership
* Cross-functional stakeholder collaboration

Why This Role Matters
  
  
This role sets the quality bar for everything IDT ships — leading the manual testing discipline that catches what matters while pushing the team toward greater automation and GenAI-enabled QA. By mentoring the engineers around them and keeping leadership clearly informed of risk, the QA Senior Engineer helps Deloitte turn breakthrough ideas into products clients can trust.
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .

They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.

title: Senior Automation Engineer, IT Help Desk
description:
HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions like bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, agentic pentesting, AI red teaming, and code security, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024).
  
  
HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best-in-class AI-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations.
  
  
**HackerOne Values**
HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is
**Customer Obsessed**
and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We
**Default to Disclosure**
by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners
**Win Together**
by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.
  
  
**Senior Automation Engineer, IT Help Desk**
Location: Pune, India (working onsite)
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
HackerOne is building an AI-native approach to Enterprise IT, where AI agents are the first line of support and every human interaction becomes an opportunity to make those agents smarter. As Senior Automation Engineer, IT Help Desk, you will build and operate this model—combining exceptional internal customer service with hands-on engineering to create AI agents, automations, and support experiences that help Hackeronies do their best work.
  
  
This is not a traditional help desk role. You will work in a highly technical, developer-heavy environment and be expected to build with AI yourself: writing code, developing and improving agents, understanding developer workflows, and using data to systematically shift support from human intervention toward automated resolution. The underlying model is Tier 1 AI Agents, Tier 2 human support/on-call, and Tier 3+ deep technical escalation to owning teams, with the explicit goal of continually moving repeatable work toward Tier 1.
  
  
We opened our new office in Pune, India to welcome team members who value in-person connection, collaboration, and shared purpose. For the types of challenges we’ll tackle and the work we’ll do together, we believe in-person connection will be essential to building strong relationships, solving problems effectively, and fostering a vibrant community.
  
  
As a fully integrated part of HackerOne’s global team, the Pune office will play a meaningful role in advancing our culture and mission. At HackerOne, we Win Together – and our Pune team will help lead the way by shaping a dynamic, in-person culture rooted in purpose and partnership.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
Success in the Senior Automation Engineer, IT Help Desk role will be accomplished by delivering on the responsibilities below in alignment with the Values and Principles that define how we work at HackerOne.
  
  

* Build an AI Native IT support experience in which AI agents serve as Tier 1, providing automated first-pass and self-service resolution before requests reach human support. Write code and build, deploy, operate, and continuously improve the agents and automations that power this experience.
* Own the effectiveness of the Tier 1 / Tier 2 / Tier 3+ support model: enable Tier 2 to resolve issues AI cannot, establish clear paths to deep technical owners at Tier 3+, and systematically turn recurring human resolutions into knowledge, tooling, and automation that can move back into Tier 1.
* Deliver an exceptional internal customer experience across a highly technical organization, supporting developer workflows and tooling while creating a clear, consistent, trusted path for Hackeronies to get help.
* Apply Data-Driven Decision Making to deeply understand support demand and performance. Instrument the support experience, identify patterns and failure modes, and use measures such as Tier 1 resolution and owning-team velocity to determine where engineering and automation can have the greatest impact.
* Use First Principles Problem Solving to attack the root cause of recurring support needs rather than repeatedly treating symptoms. Simplify systems, eliminate unnecessary work, and design durable solutions that reduce friction for employees and technical teams.
* Practice Change Agility as AI capabilities, enterprise tooling, and HackerOne’s ways of working rapidly evolve. Experiment, learn from failures, and continuously adapt the support architecture as better models, tools, and approaches become available.
* Provide technically credible support across a broad enterprise environment spanning identity and access, collaboration, endpoints, SaaS, developer tooling, APIs, data systems, and AI infrastructure, while partnering effectively with Security, Engineering, Enterprise Systems, and other owning teams for deep technical escalations.
* Establish an obsessive feedback loop between service and engineering: understand what Hackeronies are trying to accomplish, document what AI cannot yet solve, identify opportunities to improve agents and tooling, and make the support experience measurably better over time.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Significant hands-on experience supporting a technical, developer-heavy organization, with demonstrated understanding of developer workflows and tools such as Git, development environments, APIs, and AI-enabled developer tooling.
* Hands-on software development and automation experience, including demonstrated experience using AI to build working solutions—not simply consuming AI applications—with the ability to write, test, debug, deploy, and maintain code used in production workflows.
* Experience building or operating AI agents, LLM-powered applications, agentic workflows, or comparable AI automation, including integrating AI capabilities with enterprise systems, APIs, data, or internal tooling.
* Experience operating technically complex enterprise support or IT environments across areas such as identity and access, SaaS applications, collaboration platforms, endpoints, and developer tooling, with demonstrated ability to diagnose problems and determine when deep technical escalation is required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with technologies represented in HackerOne’s support environment, such as Okta, 1Password, Slack APIs, Kandji, AWS, Bedrock, Linear, Claude, ChatGPT, Workato, Google Workspace, or comparable platforms.
* Experience designing or improving tiered support, self-service, or automated service models where automation measurably reduced human support volume.
* Experience instrumenting support systems and using operational data to improve resolution rates, service quality, automation coverage, or engineering productivity.
* Experience working in a fast-moving SaaS, cybersecurity, developer-tools, or similarly technical environment.

Job Benefits:
  
  

* Health (medical, vision, dental), life, and disability insurance\*
* Equity stock options
* Retirement plans
* Paid public holidays and unlimited PTO
* Paid maternity and parental leave
* Leaves of absence (including caregiver leave and leave under CO's Healthy Families and Workplaces Act)

This policy applies to all HackerOne employment practices, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. HackerOne makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

title: Test Automation Architect
description:
**We are seeking a Test Automation Architect to define, design, and govern enterprise-scale automation solutions. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in TypeScript, Playwright, and Helenium, along with Prompt Engineering capabilities to leverage AI-driven testing and productivity use cases. The candidate must also demonstrate excellent stakeholder communication skills to drive automation strategy and quality outcomes.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Automation Architecture & Strategy**

* 10-12 years of experience in Test Automation and a minimum of 3 years on Microsoft Playwright automation tool.
* Own and define end-to-end test automation architecture across web and desktop applications.
* Design scalable, reusable, and maintainable automation frameworks using Playwright with TypeScript.
* Define automation standards, best practices, coding guidelines, and governance models.
* Evaluate applications and recommend tools, frameworks, and AI-assisted automation approaches.

**Hands-on Automation Development**

* Develop and enhance TypeScript-based automation frameworks using strong object-oriented and modular design principles.
* Build and maintain Playwright automation frameworks for modern web applications.
* Create reusable automation components, fixtures, utilities, and libraries.
* Implement reliable locator strategies, synchronization, error handling, and reporting.
* Enable parallel and distributed execution to optimize execution cycles.

**AI & Prompt Engineering**

* Apply Prompt Engineering techniques to improve test design, test-data generation, defect analysis, and automation productivity.
* Leverage AI-assisted tools for test-case generation, exploratory testing support, and automation optimization.
* Validate AI-generated tests and automation code for accuracy, coverage, maintainability, and compliance with framework standards.
* Collaborate with teams to integrate AI-driven testing approaches into existing automation frameworks.

**CI/CD & Tool Integration**

* Integrate automation frameworks with CI/CD pipelines, including Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or equivalent platforms.
* Enable automated test execution, reporting, and defect traceability.
* Support environment-based, parallel, and scheduled execution.
* Track automation metrics, execution stability, maintenance effort, and ROI.

**Stakeholder Communication & Leadership**

* Act as the automation subject-matter expert for internal and external stakeholders.
* Collaborate with product owners, architects, developers, DevOps engineers, and business teams.
* Clearly communicate automation strategy, progress, risks, dependencies, and value to senior leadership.
* Support estimation, planning, solutioning, and proposal preparation for automation initiatives.

**Mentoring & Governance**

* Mentor automation engineers and guide teams on framework usage and best practices.
* Conduct code reviews and enforce TypeScript, Playwright, and automation quality standards.
* Govern automation implementation and execution across projects to ensure consistency and quality.

**Mandatory Skills: Must Have**

* TypeScript: Mandatory
* Strong hands-on experience in TypeScript, including types, interfaces, classes, modules, promises, asynchronous programming, error handling, and reusable framework development.
* Playwright: Mandatory
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining Playwright frameworks using TypeScript, including fixtures, hooks, locators, assertions, browser contexts, storage state, tracing, retries, reporting, parallel execution, and sharding.
* Test Automation Framework Design
* Experience designing custom, hybrid, modular, and enterprise-scale automation frameworks.
* Helenium
* Experience with self-healing automation concepts, dynamic locator recovery, and integration with existing automation frameworks.
* Prompt Engineering
* Experience applying structured prompts to test design, test-data generation, defect analysis, automation development, and quality-engineering use cases.
* Experience creating reusable automation components, utilities, fixtures, libraries, and reporting solutions.
* Experience enabling parallel and distributed test execution.
* CI/CD integration experience with Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or equivalent platforms.
* Test strategy, test planning, automation estimation, and automation-candidate identification.
* Strong stakeholder communication and presentation skills.

**Nice to Have**

* API automation experience for REST services.
* Insurance domain experience, including exposure to quote, policy, billing, claims, renewals, or endorsements.
* RAG knowledge, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval relevance, groundedness, and hallucination testing.
* Exposure to GenAI and LLM application testing.
* Performance or other non-functional testing exposure.
* Agile and DevOps delivery experience.
* Enterprise-scale or multi-application automation experience.
* Docker or cloud-based test-execution exposure.

title: AI Architect
description:
**Job Description**
**Shape ZenseAI.QI and ZenseAI.AssureAI**
* Architect and evolve the platform suite across both engines: the 18\-agent ZenseAI.QI stack (DeepSpeci, CaseGeni, Auto\-PlayPilot, DataGeni, Secure\-Xi, Perf\-Xi, Insights360, RIA and Accessibility Intelligence) and the four\-pillar ZenseAI.AssureAI framework (Data Quality, Model Evaluation, Trustworthiness, and Scalability \& Security).
* Design and refine the archetype\-specific assurance lifecycles for Classical ML, Generative AI and Agentic AI, including the signature eight\-axis agentic trajectory scorecard graded on every run.
* Keep the platforms LLM\-agnostic and deployable on any client stack — on\-prem, cloud or hybrid — as model\-mixing and constant provider churn become the market norm.
* Own technical roadmap decisions for accelerators such as the Agentic Foundry (a 25\-blueprint reference matrix) and the curated, swap\-ready tooling ecosystem around each archetype.


**Lead Evaluation\-Driven Development**
* Build and govern eval suites — ground\-truth Q\&A sets, LLM\-as\-judge rubrics, frozen baselines — that gate every release rather than validate it after the fact.
* Own trajectory grading, red/purple/blue\-team probes and safety attestations for agentic and generative systems, and drift monitoring and fairness audits for classical ML.
* Translate evaluation results into release decisions: eval\-threshold gates, red\-team severity floors, canary and shadow deployments, and rollback rehearsals.
* Bring evaluation\-driven development practice into client engagements — showing, not just telling, how a live harness beats a one\-time audit.


**Own Presales and Client Proposals**
* Respond to RFPs, RFIs and client proposals across both engines, translating client requirements into a defensible solution architecture and commercial structure.
* Architect engagements across the full ladder — AI QA Assessment, AI QA Transformation, Managed AI QA — and fast\-starts such as the LLM Health Check, Agent Stress Test and Compliance Sprint.
* Build estimates, staffing plans and technical win themes that hold up under client and internal scrutiny, across client\-managed, risk\-reward and Zensar\-managed commercial models.


**Present and Articulate Value to Clients**
* Present the ZenseAI.QI and ZenseAI.AssureAI value proposition directly to client stakeholders — from QA Directors and Heads of AI/ML Engineering to CTOs, Chief Risk Officers and Chief AI Officers — adapting the narrative to each audience.
* Lead client workshops and technical walkthroughs, including guiding a CIO through the Agentic Foundry in a single session.
* Build and deliver executive trust scorecards and portfolio risk heat maps that make the assurance story board\-ready.


**Represent Zensar in Client Captives for Sales**
* Present live in client captive sessions and sales pursuits as the senior technical voice for Quality Intelligence, alongside account and sales leadership.
* Run and narrate proof\-of\-concept demonstrations that turn a client's stated risk into a small, credible proof — the practice's proof\-first approach to closing.
* Represent the practice at partner and industry forums as the practice's thought leadership and pipeline develop.


**Build Practice IP and Mentor the Next Generation**
* Contribute reusable accelerators, reference architectures and industry packs across BFSI, TMT, and Manufacturing \& Retail back into the practice's IP base.
* Mentor and help build out the practice's emerging AI\-specialist roles — Prompt Engineer, LLM\-Eval Engineer, Agent Architect, Trajectory Eval Engineer, Knowledge/RAG Engineer, AI Security Analyst and Adversarial Red/Blue Team Lead.
* Support GenAI and AI\-enablement training for QI associates across the practice.


**Responsibilities**
**Must\-Have**
* Approximately 17–21 years of overall technology experience, including a substantial, hands\-on foundation in Quality Engineering / Test Engineering — automation architecture, test strategy and the full software testing lifecycle — not AI experimentation layered on top of a thin QE background.
* Working architectural knowledge of agentic AI systems: multi\-agent orchestration, tool use, memory, and the operational risks specific to agents — unauthorised tool calls, trajectory drift, memory leakage across accounts.
* Direct experience with evaluation\-driven development: building or governing eval suites, LLM\-as\-judge frameworks, ground\-truth datasets, frozen baselines and red\-teaming / adversarial testing for generative or agentic systems.
* Strong client\-interfacing capability: comfortable owning technical content in an RFP response, presenting to CXO\-level stakeholders, and holding the room in a live client or sales captive setting.
* Ability to talk convincingly across both deterministic QE and probabilistic AI assurance — the “one estate” narrative is the core sell, and the architect has to embody it, not just recite it.
* Familiarity with the regulatory and standards backdrop shaping AI assurance conversations: EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001\.

**Job Title: MDM Quality Engineer / Test Engineer –**
****Role Overview****
 We're looking for a detail\-oriented Quality Engineer with experience in Master Data Management testing to ensure the reliability, accuracy, and performance of our MDM platform. You'll be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies across data models, integrations, match \& merge rules, workflows, and data quality processes — ensuring that master data is accurate, consistent, and fit for business use.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Design, develop, and execute test strategies and test plans for MDM implementations, including unit, functional, integration, regression, and performance testing.
* Validate Reltio data models, entity configurations, relationships, attributes, and reference data for accuracy and completeness.
* Test match \& merge rules, survivorship logic, and deduplication processes to ensure golden record quality meets business expectations.
* Validate integration pipelines (batch and real\-time) between Reltio and source/target systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes, APIs) for data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
* Perform data quality testing — profiling, validation, and reconciliation — across source systems and the Reltio MDM hub.
* Test Reltio workflows, business rules, stewardship processes, and exception handling scenarios.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts for regression and data validation testing using tools such as Python, SQL, or Selenium.
* Perform API testing of Reltio REST APIs using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or similar.
* Conduct performance and load testing on Reltio integrations and platform configurations.
* Log, track, and manage defects through the full lifecycle using JIRA or similar tools, working closely with developers to ensure timely resolution.
* Collaborate with business analysts, data stewards, and developers to understand requirements and define acceptance criteria.
* Validate data migration activities — pre\-migration, mid\-migration, and post\-migration — ensuring data integrity and completeness.
* Participate in UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and support business stakeholders during testing cycles.
* Develop and maintain test documentation including test cases, test scripts, test data, and test summary reports.
* Contribute to the definition and enforcement of QA best practices within MDM projects.


****Required Skills \& Experience****
* 3\+ years of experience in software or data quality engineering, with at least 1–2 years of exposure to MDM platforms (Reltio preferred, or Informatica MDM, Semarchy, SAP MDG, Stibo STEP, or similar).
* Hands\-on understanding of Reltio MDM concepts — entities, relationships, match \& merge, survivorship, hierarchies, and workflows — sufficient to design meaningful test cases.
* Strong SQL skills for data validation, reconciliation, and querying across relational/cloud databases.
* Experience testing REST APIs using Postman, REST Assured, or similar API testing tools.
* Experience with test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar).
* Familiarity with ETL/integration testing (validating data pipelines, transformation logic, and data flow accuracy).
* Experience with data quality testing concepts — completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to define test scenarios from complex business and data requirements.
* Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working within sprint\-based delivery teams.


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Experience with test automation frameworks (Selenium, PyTest, or similar) and scripting in Python or Groovy.
* Exposure to performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, or similar) for MDM and integration pipelines.
* Reltio platform certification or formal training is a plus.
* Experience testing Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or GCP data platforms integrated with Reltio.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.) for automated testing workflows.
* Experience with data migration testing in large\-scale MDM implementation projects.
* Knowledge of data privacy/compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA) and their impact on data quality and testing requirements.
* Experience in industries such as Manufacturing, life sciences, healthcare, retail, or financial services.


**Key Competencies**
* Meticulous attention to detail and strong data analytical mindset.
* Ability to understand complex data relationships and identify edge cases in match/merge scenarios.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills to work across data engineering, business, and architecture teams.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple test deliverables across concurrent project tracks.
* Proactive in identifying risks, raising issues early, and proposing pragmatic testing solutions.

 Role

title: Engineering Manager -Embedded Automation Testing
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Engineering Manager \-Embedded Automation Testing
 



**Experience:** 
 12\+ Years
 



**Location :** 
 Bangalore and Pune
 



**Roles and Responsibilities:** 




**Role Overview:** 



* Design Python\-based automated test frameworks to validate embedded firmware and motor control systems.
* Driving cross\-functional team performance, mentoring engineers, and aligning client requirements with technical deliverables.
* Automation: Build HIL/SIL test pipelines, regression suites, and custom Python tools for data analysis and reporting.
* Domain Focus: Validate BLDC, PMSM, and FOC algorithms using oscilloscopes, current sensors, and motor test benches.
* Analysis: Test PWM signals, ADC sampling, control loops, and communication protocols.
* Planning: Develop test plans, verification protocols, and maintain full requirements traceability.
* Integration: Collaborate with hardware and firmware teams to perform root cause analysis and board bring\-up.

* Leadership: Mentor junior engineers, drive test coverage improvements, and provide testability feedback in design reviews.
* Preferred Experience: Real\-time operating systems (FreeRTOS/Zephyr) and industrial HIL rigs (dSPACE/NI/Speedgoat).
* Ideal Candidate: Strong problem\-solver with a background in robotics, automotive, or industrial motor automation.



**Qualification: B.E/ B.Tech**

 NXP’s Wireless Connectivity group is building the next generation of wireless chipsets for Automotive, Gaming, IoT, Industrial and Smart\-Home devices.
 



 These chipsets will define ultra\-low power, high performance and low latency benchmarks for products that rely on Wi\-Fi, BT/BLE and 802\.15\.4

* Working with Marketing, Sales and Field Application Engineers to understand customers use cases and requirements, and influence next generation products



  





**Qualifications\-**

* Experience with C programming and debugging is a must
* Very good understanding on Networking components like TCP/IP
* Having a background on Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth, 15\.4 protocol a significant advantage
* Exposure to ARM processor architecture is required
* Experience with SDIO/PCIe/USB bus interface is preferred
* Need to work independently on tasks from understanding the requirements, to design, implementation and testing. Also need to work cross function teams
* Effective interpersonal, teamwork, and communication skills
